Firefighters face a 14% higher risk of dying from cancer than the general public because of repeated exposure to toxic chemicals from burning materials. This legislation will expand federal grant funding so local departments can provide cancer prevention initiatives and multi-cancer early detection testing. Early detection gives firefighters a fighting chance.

**If you run into burning buildings for us, we will run through walls for you.**

This is what bipartisan problem-solving looks like. I need your support to keep fighting for solutions that actually matter.

| | Early last year, Elon Musk and Donald Trump seized control of the highly sensitive payment system at the Treasury Department. It gave them access to a trove of highly sensitive information about Americans that pay into Social Security, receive Medicare payments, the money owed to government workers, and much more. I rallied with the people to send a clear message to Trump, Musk, and the DOGE goons: **get your hands off our money, and get the hell out.** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127752659/609120381/-2044921950?refcode=2026-03-20-ss&recurring=0&amount=8&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=a2968373-ce24-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMjk2ODM3My1jZTI0LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Vixmud294YuS7sNPaz_4RpHgnlrdEvuY9MOHCqzLKVw=)** This month, a whistleblower complaint laid bare one of the worst fears I had back then: that Americans' Social Security data would be mishandled, exposed, and exploited. **A former DOGE employee allegedly took a thumb drive containing the Social Security information of**** _hundreds of millions_ of _ _****people to a new job.** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127752660/609120382/-2044921950?refcode=2026-03-20-ss&recurring=0&amount=8&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=a2968373-ce24-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMjk2ODM3My1jZTI0LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Vixmud294YuS7sNPaz_4RpHgnlrdEvuY9MOHCqzLKVw=)** This would be one of the worst data breaches in history. But it didn't happen because we were hacked by a foreign power, or because of some massive computer error. **It happened because Trump's administration wanted to exploit people's most private information for political gain.** Normally when a bank gets robbed, the thieves have to forcefully break in. But imagine if the bank manager (of their own free will) happily handed the thieves the keys to the vault – and then shared in the profits of the heist. That's the best way to describe how Trump opened the doors of our government to Musk and DOGE, and all that's followed. It gave them access to a trove of highly sensitive information about Americans that pay into Social Security, receive Medicare payments, the money owed to government workers, and much more. I rallied with the people to send a clear message to Trump, Musk, and the DOGE goons: get your hands off our money, and get the hell out. = This month, a whistleblower complaint laid bare one of the worst fears I had back then: that Americans' Social Security data would be mishandled, exposed, and exploited. A former DOGE employee allegedly took a thumb drive containing the Social Security information of hundreds of millions of people to a new job. = This would be one of the worst data breaches in history. But it didn't happen because we were hacked by a foreign power, or because of some massive computer error. It happened because Trump's administration wanted to exploit people's most private information for political gain. Normally when a bank gets robbed, the thieves have to forcefully break in. But imagine if the bank manager (of their own free will) happily handed the thieves the keys to the vault – and then shared in the profits of the heist. That's the best way to describe how Trump opened the doors of our government to Musk and DOGE, and all that's followed. name: Tom Fitton
subject: FBI Finds 1.9M Records in “Hidden Room”
body:
Supreme Court Argument on Single Election Day

[INSIDE JW]

FBI FINDS 1.9M JACK SMITH–LINKED RECORDS IN HIDDEN ROOM

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=37410&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9rZEFvNE9PX01wTT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=83c3bd3143f83049046e9fc2fe15c92c8f731d90c3667b129cb5e125a13357f8]

Here’s a discovery that will break the news cycle in the coming
weeks.The U.S. Department of Justice Department has reported
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=37404&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWhpZGRlbi1yb29tLWpzci0wNDA0Ny8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=5b0804e79868d3363f52a7582c33787bc5ea2942a0c363f391d0cc57e391828c]
that the FBI found about 1.9 million pages of records in response to
our Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit. These documents were
reportedly stored in a “hidden room” at FBI headquarters and were
first revealed by former Deputy Director Dan Bongino (_Judicial Watch
v U.S. Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=36534&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWZiaS1oaWRkZW4tcm9vbS1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDQwNDcvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=93811d0f9f5804a35881ffcdd110866fcc7a9c266fa0c002097c9c7e356675b6]
(No.1:25-cv-04047)).

According to the FBI’s filing
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=37404&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWhpZGRlbi1yb29tLWpzci0wNDA0Ny8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=5b0804e79868d3363f52a7582c33787bc5ea2942a0c363f391d0cc57e391828c],
the Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) contains
several safes holding between approximately 950,000 and 1,900,000
pages of records. The FBI estimates that processing these materials
could take up to a year:

> The Complaint (ECF No. 1) in this action asks for three items of
> records.
>
> For item 1, Plaintiff seeks “[a]ll documents referenced by Deputy
> Director Dan Bongino” (emphasis added) concerning a room located
> in FBI Headquarters. The room referenced is a Sensitive
> Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) that houses records
> related to both closed and open investigations. The FBI continues to
> assess the contents of the room and the total volume of records in
> the room. The FBI continues to determine what records, if any, are
> responsive to the request.
>
> Until all documents have been digitized and reviewed, the Defendant
> cannot identify the anticipated number of documents responsive to
> the request or the anticipated date(s) for release of the requested
> documents. The FBI can provide the following update about the status
> of this process. Specifically, the FBI has assessed that the room
> presently contains the following records that require digitization
> before they can be scoped for responsiveness and processed for
> production: several five-drawer filing cabinets (safes) that the FBI
> estimates to include approximately, between 950,000 and 1,900,000
> pages (which may fluctuate depending on whether there is material on
> both the front and back of the pages). The FBI estimates that volume
> of records will take between 10 to 12 months to process.
>
> The records appear to include the following:

>> Legacy Files: These records consist of older legacy records, the
>> majority of which relate to two closed, historical investigations.
>> These records belong to the DOJ Office of Inspector General (OIG),
>> and prior to release, must be sent to the DOJ OIG for consultation
>> on its equities in the records.

>> Other files: These records consist of more recent records related
>> to various investigations, including, for example, active
>> investigations and prior Special Counsel investigative records,
>> many of which are likely to require consultation with other
>> government agencies prior to release.

> Following the digitization of the records described above, the FBI
> must scope the records for responsiveness and then process the
> records and complete consultations with other government agencies.
> Given the records’ subject matters and storage in a SCIF, it is
> also likely the records will need to be reviewed for classification
> issues.

> To reduce the workload associated with this process, the parties
> will confer to determine whether it’s possible to reduce the scope
> of the records at issue for item 1. The parties will report on the
> result of those discussions in the next joint status report.

Items 2 and 3 seek the following records:

> “All internal FBI communications among officials in the offices of
> FBI Director Kash Patel and FBI Deputy Director Dan Bongino related
> to the discovery of these documents.”
>
> “All directives sent to officials from the offices of the Director
> and/or Deputy Director regarding the handling and disposition of the
> documents referenced in Bullet 1.”
>
> For items 2 and 3, the FBI continues its search for responsive
> records located in any database systems, SharePoint sites, as well
> as paper or manual files. The parties will provide an update on the
> status of the search for records potentially responsive to Items 2
> and 3 in the next joint status report.

The court filing comes in the Judicial Watch lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=36553&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZmJpLXJlY29yZHMtc2VjcmV0LXJvb20vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=02717cbe4addc9e0aaa3fe851585ee6dde5d1dd0c73f138fab039c6d05081307] filed last
year, after the FBI, a component of the Justice Department, failed to
respond to a June 2025 FOIA request for:

> 1. All documents referenced by Deputy Director Dan Bongino as having
> been discovered in a room “hidden from us and not mentioned to
> us,” discussed in a Fox News interview at
> https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=36536&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9saWJzb2Z0aWt0b2svc3RhdHVzLzE5MjgwOTk0NTUwOTU0MjczODM7P3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=bf2b72d427fd8c779695c0417ee9689adcdb7f6276572a51235b79f33f636d31
>
> 2. All internal FBI communications among officials in the offices of
> FBI Director Kash Patel and FBI Deputy Director Dan Bongino related
> to the discovery of these documents; and
>
> 3. All directives sent to officials from the offices of the Director
> and/or Deputy Director regarding the handling and disposition of the
> documents.

In a Fox News interview
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=37405&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZm94bmV3cy5jb20vdmlkZW8vNjM3MzYwNjg0MjExMl1vbj91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=522bffecdff4cb16b8558e9943afd2a4e5c9b3f8dba8b5b24c39618b14628b06 May 29, 2025, then-FBI
Deputy Director Bongino stated:

> There was a room [in FBI Headquarters], and we found stuff. A lot of
> stuff ... hidden from us at least and not mentioned to us. And then
> found stuff in there. A lot is from the Comey era. We are working
> ... right now to declassify. And just so you know, because I get the
> public—I totally understand people saying “well do it now.”
> The process is: not all of the information is ours to declassify.
> Some is other intelligence agencies’.... We literally can’t do
> it. Once that gets done ... and you read some of the stuff we
> found—that, by the way, was not processed through the normal
> procedure, digitizing and putting in FBI records. We found it in
> bags, hiding under Jim Comey’s FBI. You’re going to be stunned.

In July 2025, Senate Judiciary Committee Chairman Chuck Grassley
issued a press release
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=36604&F=T&&hash=2de4ebcf1f155e5192838159ca99634c43d115bc3153383c39ee0887bab9be1e]
titled “Clinton Campaign Plan to Falsely Tie Trump to Russia and
FBI’s Failure to Investigate” concerning additional Comey-era
events. Grassley made public the formerly Classified Appendix
(“Durham annex”)
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=37406&F=T&&hash=6f75f7fbc72017905dc481f2ed5a4727f3bc8acdba43d22f384efa27a2c1a84d]
to John Durham’s 2023 Special Counsel report
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=29536&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVzdGljZS5nb3Yvc3RvcmFnZS9kdXJoYW1yZXBvcnQucGRmP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=e89f5d0686fc833b158560519c357d875b0369941bcf8682b09caae95e497116]. Grassley’s
office stated:

> The Durham annex contains previously classified information exposing
> a reported Clinton campaign plan to falsely tie President Donald
> Trump to Russia.

The annex also goes into further detail on matters discussed in the
Unclassified Report, specifically:

*
Potential election influence by a foreign government regarding Hillary
Clinton;

*
False statements to the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court (FISA
court) regarding FISA renewal applications for Carter Page;

*
The FBI’s failure – under the leadership of then-Director James
Comey – to investigate intelligence that the Clinton campaign may
have created the Russia collusion hoax. Meanwhile the Comey-led FBI
used the Steele Dossier – a Clinton campaign creation – to obtain
FISA warrants on Carter Page.

Despite the passage of nine months since the “hidden room” records
request and four months since the lawsuit was filed, the Bureau has
yet to provide an estimated completion date for its search, the number
of responsive records for key categories, or a timeline for production
of documents.

In the March 12 filing
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=37404&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWhpZGRlbi1yb29tLWpzci0wNDA0Ny8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=5b0804e79868d3363f52a7582c33787bc5ea2942a0c363f391d0cc57e391828c],
we urged the court to compel the FBI to complete its search for key
records within 60 days and to establish a firm production schedule.

The court responded quickly, ordering the FBI to disclose how many
high-level, internal FBI communications and directives exist about
handling these secret documents by the next filing on May 11, 2026.

This is an astonishing and troubling revelation. The FBI and Justice
Department must go all out to release the nearly 2 million secret FBI
and DOJ files on the lawfare against Trump and whatever else the Obama
and Biden gangs don’t want Americans to know about. I have no doubt
these records are far more important than the Epstein files.

This is the latest in a series of Judicial Watch investigations
targeting shady FBI weaponization and abuse of power.

In August 2025, we sued
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=35947&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY29tZXktaW52ZXN0aWdhdGlvbi1vZi10cnVtcC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=416a83411f15fd7a601490c2303c510c6a3b889164a4f3311fb58ac99add8747] the
Justice Department for all records regarding the FBI, under
then-Director James Comey, initiating an investigation of then-2016
presidential candidate Donald Trump.

In May 2020, we uncovered the FBI “EC”—the electronic
communication
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=27289&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZGVjbGFzc2lmaWNhdGlvbi1zcHlvcGVyYXRpb24vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=3a1b43d0625d492ff6f58d513df737e96f286445766ff0ea9a6a80c8bb6c6985] that
officially launched the counterintelligence investigation, termed
“Crossfire Hurricane,” of Trump’s 2016 presidential campaign.
The document was written by former FBI official Peter Strzok and was
obtained as the result of a Judicial Watch FOIA lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=15558&F=T&&hash=b7c08305c6ca35f59b18132e9d8002ada601cdc2d8df1a9960ce7a26555d7ed5]
for: “The Electronic Communication that initiated the
counterintelligence investigation of Trump’s 2016 presidential
campaign.”

In August 2019, we uncovered “302” report material
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=27816&F=T&&hash=f65f0c5817b1ad52e705d7e54f31d55412281909a504472c4f2fc6f839a98da7]
from FBI interviews with Bruce Ohr, who was removed from his position
as U.S. Associate Deputy Attorney General in December 2017.

In March 2019, we received
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=27815&F=T&&hash=5d6bf8e97871d2482afeff76ec8eb409cdb5337e36d680915f5b5b54d3af309d]
heavily redacted records from the Justice Department that reveal that
Ohr remained in regular contact with former British spy and Fusion GPS
contractor Christopher Steele after Steele was terminated
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=9132&F=T&&hash=59d5ba0bba286c67494aa3679feabfab093e3eff4d1a295805048543dd3284e8]
by the FBI in November 2016 for revealing to the media his position as
an FBI confidential informant.

In December 2018, we uncovered
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=37407&F=T&&hash=2d171262f68a9a8cfe8535a2fb9a28a85f3d62d461c24514c28a5a917c20a87d]
U.S. State Department documents showing classified information was
researched and disseminated to multiple U.S. Senators by the Obama
administration immediately prior to Trump’s inauguration. The
documents reveal that among those receiving the classified documents
were Sen. Mark Warner (D-VA), Sen. Ben Cardin (D-MD), and Sen. Robert
Corker (R-TN). Judicial Watch obtained the documents through a FOIA
lawsuit for records of the Obama State Department’s last-minute
efforts to share classified information about Russia election
interference issues with Cardin.

In August 2018, we announced that in response to a its FOIA lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=7528&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnQtYXJjaGl2ZS9qdy12LWRvai1maXNhLXRyYW5zY3JpcHRzLWNvbXBsYWludC0wMTA1MC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=d1c9ba8061700520141509000a38ace33f396ba559c7501d5d7dd1e094213f8a],
the Justice Department admitted in a court filing
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=9647&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnQtYXJjaGl2ZS9qdy12LWRvai1maXNhLW5vLWhlYXJpbmdzLW5vLXRyYW5zY3JpcHRzLTAxMDUwLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=0fd96fd79099f5c80dbb8d2402dfb4fa28d8b1826ea2cd50c73630c3de7701cd]
that the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court held no hearings on
the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act (FISA) spy warrant
applications targeting Carter Page, a former Trump campaign part-time
advisor who was the subject of four controversial FISA warrants.

Also in August, we forced the release
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=27820&F=T&&hash=f1d2a0aeff286edf5ea7433680f7d752269cb1b7d96aa45e21ea546c008b0378]
of heavily redacted records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=9156&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnQtYXJjaGl2ZS9qdy12LWRvai0wMDkxNi1jb21wbGV0ZS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=30480db75bc2d3aa43d93b562d6107ba44bbe073558d3a47a12e68e01a20355b]
about Christopher Steele, the former British spy, hired with Clinton
campaign and Democratic National Committee funds, who authored the
infamous dossier targeting Trump during last year’s presidential
campaign. The documents show that Steele was cut off as a
“Confidential Human Source” (CHS) after he disclosed his
relationship with the FBI to a third party. The documents also show at
least 11 FBI payments to Steele in 2016 and document that he was
admonished for unknown reasons in February 2016.

In July 2018, we released documents
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=27819&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvanVkaWNpYWwtd2F0Y2gtb2J0YWlucy1jYXJ0ZXItcGFnZS1maXNhLWNvdXJ0LWRvY3VtZW50cy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=9ed538cb5152d7df90e0540df92ec29e0aa761b83bf05db31fd07a7c419c4ded]
about FISA warrants targeting Carter Page, who had been a Trump
campaign adviser.

SUPREME COURT ARGUMENT ON SINGLE ELECTION DAY SET FOR MARCH 23

The Supreme Court will hold an oral argument
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=80334&L=37093&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuc3VwcmVtZWNvdXJ0Lmdvdi9zZWFyY2guYXNweD9maWxlbmFtZT0vZG9ja2V0L2RvY2tldGZpbGVzL2h0bWwvcHVibGljLzI0LTEyNjAuaHRtbCZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=da4c11666752297155c8f06ad9b76f307bc19bac95f24199ee0897b862e3acdb]
on March 23 in a landmark election integrity case over whether the
federal Election Day laws prohibit the counting of mail-in ballots

that the ordinary meaning of “election” at the time Congress
enacted the statutes includes the full process of voting and the

a relatively recent practice without any historic foundation. Allowing
ballots to “trickle in” after Election Day creates opportunities
for fraud and erodes public confidence.

Our brief points out:

> The whole point of the federal Election-Day statutes is to set a
> single uniform day for the election. Allowing ballots to trickle in
> days or weeks after Election Day is antithetical to that basic goal.
> Indeed, a patchwork of state ballot-receipt deadlines replicates the
> problems Congress was trying to remedy with a single national
> Election Day. It is entirely implausible to conclude that
> Congress—when thrice exercising its preemptive power under the
> Elections and Electors Clauses—left the door open for states to
> vitiate those statutes by postponing electoral outcomes with
> post-election ballot-receipt deadlines. Congress certainly did not
> leave states the power to undo this important federal time
> regulation by simply declaring all mailboxes to be ballot boxes.

***

> Through the federal Election-Day statutes, Congress exercised its
> constitutional authority to set a uniform time for federal elections
> to occur. Text, historical practice, precedent, and common sense all
> demonstrate that those statutes set the deadline by which ballots
> must be submitted and received. Simply put, the ballot box closes on
> Election Day, and ballots that are not received until days or weeks
> after the date specified by Congress arrive after Election Day and
> should not be counted.

Congress set a uniform national Election Day, meaning the “ballot
box closes” on that day.

Federal law sets one Election Day. That deadline should be enforced.
This case goes to whether federal election law will be applied as
written. Congress established a single, uniform Election Day, and
states cannot override that mandate with extended ballot-receipt
deadlines. Allowing ballots to arrive after Election Day creates
uncertainty, invites fraud, and erodes public confidence. The Supreme
Court now has a critical opportunity to restore a clear national
standard.

clean_body: Supreme Court Argument on Single Election Day [INSIDE JW] FBI FINDS 1.9M JACK SMITH–LINKED RECORDS IN HIDDEN ROOM [] Here’s a discovery that will break the news cycle in the coming weeks.The U.S. Department of Justice Department has reported [] that the FBI found about 1.9 million pages of records in response to our Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit. These documents were reportedly stored in a “hidden room” at FBI headquarters and were first revealed by former Deputy Director Dan Bongino (Judicial Watch v U.S. Department of Justice [] (No.1:25-cv-04047)). According to the FBI’s filing [], the Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) contains several safes holding between approximately 950,000 and 1,900,000 pages of records. The FBI estimates that processing these materials could take up to a year: The Complaint (ECF No. 1) in this action asks for three items of records. For item 1, Plaintiff seeks “[a]ll documents referenced by Deputy Director Dan Bongino” (emphasis added) concerning a room located in FBI Headquarters. The room referenced is a Sensitive Compartmented Information Facility (SCIF) that houses records related to both closed and open investigations. The FBI continues to assess the contents of the room and the total volume of records in the room. The FBI continues to determine what records, if any, are responsive to the request. Until all documents have been digitized and reviewed, the Defendant cannot identify the anticipated number of documents responsive to the request or the anticipated date(s) for release of the requested documents. The FBI can provide the following update about the status of this process. Specifically, the FBI has assessed that the room presently contains the following records that require digitization before they can be scoped for responsiveness and processed for production: several five-drawer filing cabinets (safes) that the FBI estimates to include approximately, between 950,000 and 1,900,000 pages (which may fluctuate depending on whether there is material on both the front and back of the pages). The FBI estimates that volume of records will take between 10 to 12 months to process. The records appear to include the following: > Legacy Files: These records consist of older legacy records, the > majority of which relate to two closed, historical investigations. > These records belong to the DOJ Office of Inspector General (OIG), > and prior to release, must be sent to the DOJ OIG for consultation > on its equities in the records. > Other files: These records consist of more recent records related > to various investigations, including, for example, active > investigations and prior Special Counsel investigative records, > many of which are likely to require consultation with other > government agencies prior to release. Following the digitization of the records described above, the FBI must scope the records for responsiveness and then process the records and complete consultations with other government agencies. Given the records’ subject matters and storage in a SCIF, it is also likely the records will need to be reviewed for classification issues. To reduce the workload associated with this process, the parties will confer to determine whether it’s possible to reduce the scope of the records at issue for item 1. The parties will report on the result of those discussions in the next joint status report. Items 2 and 3 seek the following records: “All internal FBI communications among officials in the offices of FBI Director Kash Patel and FBI Deputy Director Dan Bongino related to the discovery of these documents.” “All directives sent to officials from the offices of the Director and/or Deputy Director regarding the handling and disposition of the documents referenced in Bullet 1.” For items 2 and 3, the FBI continues its search for responsive records located in any database systems, SharePoint sites, as well as paper or manual files. The parties will provide an update on the status of the search for records potentially responsive to Items 2 and 3 in the next joint status report. The court filing comes in the Judicial Watch lawsuit [] filed last year, after the FBI, a component of the Justice Department, failed to respond to a June 2025 FOIA request for: 1. All documents referenced by Deputy Director Dan Bongino as having been discovered in a room “hidden from us and not mentioned to us,” discussed in a Fox News interview at 2. All internal FBI communications among officials in the offices of FBI Director Kash Patel and FBI Deputy Director Dan Bongino related to the discovery of these documents; and 3. All directives sent to officials from the offices of the Director and/or Deputy Director regarding the handling and disposition of the documents. In a Fox News interview [ May 29, 2025, then-FBI Deputy Director Bongino stated: There was a room [in FBI Headquarters], and we found stuff. A lot of stuff ... hidden from us at least and not mentioned to us. And then found stuff in there. A lot is from the Comey era. We are working ... right now to declassify. And just so you know, because I get the public—I totally understand people saying “well do it now.” The process is: not all of the information is ours to declassify. Some is other intelligence agencies’.... We literally can’t do it. Once that gets done ... and you read some of the stuff we found—that, by the way, was not processed through the normal procedure, digitizing and putting in FBI records. We found it in bags, hiding under Jim Comey’s FBI. You’re going to be stunned. In July 2025, Senate Judiciary Committee Chairman Chuck Grassley issued a press release [] titled “Clinton Campaign Plan to Falsely Tie Trump to Russia and FBI’s Failure to Investigate” concerning additional Comey-era events. Grassley made public the formerly Classified Appendix (“Durham annex”) [] to John Durham’s 2023 Special Counsel report []. Grassley’s office stated: The Durham annex contains previously classified information exposing a reported Clinton campaign plan to falsely tie President Donald Trump to Russia. The annex also goes into further detail on matters discussed in the Unclassified Report, specifically: Potential election influence by a foreign government regarding Hillary Clinton; False statements to the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Court (FISA court) regarding FISA renewal applications for Carter Page; The FBI’s failure – under the leadership of then-Director James Comey – to investigate intelligence that the Clinton campaign may have created the Russia collusion hoax. Meanwhile the Comey-led FBI used the Steele Dossier – a Clinton campaign creation – to obtain FISA warrants on Carter Page. Despite the passage of nine months since the “hidden room” records request and four months since the lawsuit was filed, the Bureau has yet to provide an estimated completion date for its search, the number of responsive records for key categories, or a timeline for production of documents. In the March 12 filing [], we urged the court to compel the FBI to complete its search for key records within 60 days and to establish a firm production schedule. The court responded quickly, ordering the FBI to disclose how many high-level, internal FBI communications and directives exist about handling these secret documents by the next filing on May 11, 2026. This is an astonishing and troubling revelation. In May 2020, we uncovered the FBI “EC”—the electronic communication [] that officially launched the counterintelligence investigation, termed “Crossfire Hurricane,” of Trump’s 2016 presidential campaign. The document was written by former FBI official Peter Strzok and was obtained as the result of a Judicial Watch FOIA lawsuit [] for: “The Electronic Communication that initiated the counterintelligence investigation of Trump’s 2016 presidential campaign.” In August 2019, we uncovered “302” report material [] from FBI interviews with Bruce Ohr, who was removed from his position as U.S. Associate Deputy Attorney General in December 2017. In March 2019, we received [] heavily redacted records from the Justice Department that reveal that Ohr remained in regular contact with former British spy and Fusion GPS contractor Christopher Steele after Steele was terminated [] by the FBI in November 2016 for revealing to the media his position as an FBI confidential informant. In December 2018, we uncovered [] U.S. State Department documents showing classified information was researched and disseminated to multiple U.S. Senators by the Obama administration immediately prior to Trump’s inauguration. The documents reveal that among those receiving the classified documents were Sen. Mark Warner (D-VA), Sen. Ben Cardin (D-MD), and Sen. Robert Corker (R-TN). Judicial Watch obtained the documents through a FOIA lawsuit for records of the Obama State Department’s last-minute efforts to share classified information about Russia election interference issues with Cardin. Also in August, we forced the release [] of heavily redacted records [] about Christopher Steele, the former British spy, hired with Clinton campaign and Democratic National Committee funds, who authored the infamous dossier targeting Trump during last year’s presidential campaign. The documents show that Steele was cut off as a “Confidential Human Source” (CHS) after he disclosed his relationship with the FBI to a third party. The documents also show at least 11 FBI payments to Steele in 2016 and document that he was admonished for unknown reasons in February 2016. In July 2018, we released documents [] about FISA warrants targeting Carter Page, who had been a Trump campaign adviser. The public can listen to the oral arguments here []. We brought the underlying lawsuit on behalf of the Libertarian Party of Mississippi. We have partnered with former Solicitor General Paul Clement, who will present our argument to the High Court next week. Our legal team seeks to uphold a historic ruling [] by the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit, which found that Mississippi’s counting of ballots received up to five days after Election Day to be unlawful. Republican National Committee et al [ (No. 24-1260)) (Libertarian Party of Mississippi v. Wetzel et al. [] (No. 1:24-cv-00037)). We argue [] that the ordinary meaning of “election” at the time Congress enacted the statutes includes the full process of voting and the receipt of ballots by officials. Counting post-Election Day ballots is a relatively recent practice without any historic foundation. Allowing ballots to “trickle in” after Election Day creates opportunities for fraud and erodes public confidence. Our brief points out: The whole point of the federal Election-Day statutes is to set a single uniform day for the election. Allowing ballots to trickle in days or weeks after Election Day is antithetical to that basic goal. Indeed, a patchwork of state ballot-receipt deadlines replicates the problems Congress was trying to remedy with a single national Election Day. It is entirely implausible to conclude that Congress—when thrice exercising its preemptive power under the Elections and Electors Clauses—left the door open for states to vitiate those statutes by postponing electoral outcomes with post-election ballot-receipt deadlines. Congress certainly did not leave states the power to undo this important federal time regulation by simply declaring all mailboxes to be ballot boxes. Through the federal Election-Day statutes, Congress exercised its constitutional authority to set a uniform time for federal elections to occur. Text, historical practice, precedent, and common sense all demonstrate that those statutes set the deadline by which ballots must be submitted and received. Simply put, the ballot box closes on Election Day, and ballots that are not received until days or weeks after the date specified by Congress arrive after Election Day and should not be counted. Congress set a uniform national Election Day, meaning the “ballot box closes” on that day. Federal law sets one Election Day. That deadline should be enforced. This case goes to whether federal election law will be applied as written. Congress established a single, uniform Election Day, and states cannot override that mandate with extended ballot-receipt deadlines. Allowing ballots to arrive after Election Day creates uncertainty, invites fraud, and erodes public confidence. The Supreme Court now has a critical opportunity to restore a clear national standard. name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: This one will stump you.
body:
Definitions matter. Logic matters. Clear thinking matters.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpu420lkncdjn158s40fral4oid6d17kkhdr6bgg_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c1geeoj1c3h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

Let me start with a lighthearted question:

**Is a chicken a man?**

The Greek philosopher Plato was once cheered for defining a human being as a "featherless biped."

So, Diogenes the Cynic plucked a chicken, carried it into Plato's school, and declared, "Here is Plato's man!"

We share this story in our newest free online course, **" Classical Logic and Rhetoric**," because it captures something important in a surprisingly memorable way.

**Definitions matter. Logic matters. Clear thinking matters.**

Because when we lose the ability to define simple things...we lose much more than an argument.

**We lose our grip on reality itself.**

And when a culture accepts claims without examining them--when it confuses feelings with facts and cannot recognize flawed reasoning--**self-government becomes impossible.**

Today, it's not likely Americans are confusing plucked chickens for men (I hope!). But wouldn't you agree that we seem more confused and disconnected than ever?

We must be able to think clearly about truth, nature, and even what it means to be human. This confusion didn't appear overnight.

It is the predictable result of a long failure in too many schools.

**For decades, too many young people have _not_ been taught to think clearly or communicate effectively.**

[**That 's why Hillsdale College has launched a new FREE online course, "Classical Logic and Rhetoric."**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrmppa9n0ssta8kvl3dga0qdcemrrk3fqvq9i4eo_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c1geeoj1c3h2bs)

This course teaches the foundations of clear reasoning and persuasive argument, which are the intellectual tools that sustain ordered liberty and self-government.

**But here is the urgent part:** To place this course in front of millions of Americans--especially young Americans--**we must raise $100,000 by March 31.**

Without this funding, our ability to promote and distribute this course nationwide will be severely limited.

That means fewer students will encounter it. Fewer families will share it. Fewer young citizens will learn HOW to think clearly in an age of confusion.

**That 's where you come in.**

You understand that education is our surest defense of liberty. You know that to prevent confusion, students must learn how to judge whether something is true.

**Your gift today, whether $15, $25, $50, or more, will promote and share this course nationwide.**

You will help ensure that clear thinking and speaking have a place in a culture that desperately needs them.

And you will help restore the intellectual foundations that make freedom possible.

**Please make your most generous tax-deductible gift now to help us meet our $100,000 goal by March 31 using this secure link: **

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/classical-logic-and-rhetoric-support](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbtnrgo7jvb3fm29asvij4qh0k0784gur90ku3e8_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c1geeoj1c3h2bs)

Once you've made your gift, you'll receive early access to the course. It is our gift to you, and to every American who wants to speak and think carefully.

If we succeed, thousands more Americans can learn the principles of logic and rhetoric that built Western Civilization.

If we fall short, fewer Americans will learn how to distinguish truth from error. Like mistaking plucked chickens for men ;).

**The next generation will inherit whatever we choose to defend...or ignore...today.**

Your support pursues truth and defends liberty. Please make your most generous gift today.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

**P.S. A culture that cannot think clearly or speak persuasively about truth cannot defend liberty. Please help us raise $100,000 by March 31** to promote our newest free online course, "**Classical Logic and Rhetoric** ," nationwide to millions.

**Make your best tax-deductible gift now using the secure link below and then begin the course yourself when it launches.

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/classical-logic-and-rhetoric-support](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuse23o6q5uj6071q6u335cn7jalc0jipt15tp8o_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c1geeoj1c3h2bs)

body:
Dear Hoosier Republicans, No images? [Click here](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-e-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-id/) _**Continuing the Work for Hoosier Families**_ Dear Hoosier Republicans,Hoosiers want policies that help families get ahead, support job creators, and keep communities strong. They expect leaders who focus on lowering costs, expanding opportunity, and ensuring that hard work still leads to a better future. From expanding job opportunities and supporting workforce development to improving public safety and protecting our constitutional freedoms, our focus remains on the commonsense priorities that matter most to Hoosier families.The 2026 elections will be critical for maintaining the progress Indiana has made under strong Republican leadership. That means building momentum, supporting our candidates up and down the ballot, and ensuring every Hoosier understands what is at stake. With a shared commitment to conservative principles and a growing coalition across the state, Republicans are well positioned to carry this momentum into 2026 and deliver another decisive victory for our party and our state.As always, thank you for being a part of our team, and please feel free to reach out if there's any way I can be of assistance.Yours in service, Lana Keesling, Indiana GOP Chairwoman _**Gov. Braun Invests Record-Breaking Commitment in Agriculture & Life Sciences, $1 Billion to Grow Over 100K New Jobs in 10 Years **_ Governor Mike Braun has announced a transformative $1 billion investment to position Indiana as a national leader in agriculture and life sciences, with the goal of creating 100,000 high-wage jobs over the next decade. By partnering with major industry leaders like Eli Lilly and Company and Elanco Animal Health, as well as top research institutions such as Purdue University and Indiana University, Braun's plan focuses on driving innovation, boosting wages, and strengthening Indiana's role as a hub for cutting-edge economic growth."Indiana is leading in life sciences, and today we're investing to accelerate that growth with the goal of creating 100,000 new high wage jobs over the next 10 years. Based on measurable outcomes to ensure accountability and long-term ROI, this investment will make Indiana the re-shoring and expansion epicenter and premier destination for human therapeutics, animal health, agritech, biotechnology, and environmental innovation."\- Governor Braun via a [press release](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-r/) _**Governor Braun Reaffirms Free Speech with Turning Point USA Partnership**_ Governor Mike Braun partnered with Turning Point USA to reaffirm freedom of speech as a foundational American value and encourage open dialogue across Indiana schools and universities. Braun issued a proclamation highlighting the importance of protecting constitutional rights, promoting civic engagement, and supporting student organizations that foster discussion of liberty and American values."I call on all schools and universities in Indiana to take all necessary steps to facilitate student organizations like Turning Point USA that foster the values of liberty and freedom of speech in the next generation of Hoosiers." \- Governor Braun via a [press release](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-y/) _**Chairwoman's County Visits: 10**_ **Adams County** **Allen County** **Kosciusko County** **Franklin County** _**Chairman's Award Recipients**_ **Becky Bechtel** Becky Bechtel is a lifelong Republican who has spent decades serving the party through both professional and volunteer roles on campaigns across Indiana and the nation. >From supporting leaders like Richard Lugar, Susan Brooks, Eric Holcomb, and Mitch Daniels, to leading locally as Washington Township GOP's Chair and a longtime precinct committeewoman, Becky's dedication and leadership have made a lasting impact on the Republican Party in Indiana. **Karen Shelton** Karen Shelton is being recognized for decades of dedicated service to both the Republican Party and her community. From serving 20 years on the county central committee and holding leadership roles including treasurer, secretary, and vice chair, to her extensive volunteer work with local organizations and ministries, Karen's commitment has strengthened Steuben County and exemplified the spirit of service that sustains our party. **Jerry Hunefeld** Jerry Hunefeld is being honored for nearly five decades of dedicated public service, including an extraordinary 46 years on the county council where he provided steady leadership and guidance for his community. A respected educator for 41 years and recipient of the Sagamore of the Wabash, Jerry's lifelong commitment to service, integrity, and responsible government has left a lasting impact on generations of Hoosiers. **2026 State Convention** [Click Here for More Information](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-j/) [Individual Registration](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-t/) [Organization Registration](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-i/) _**Indiana GOP is Hiring Interns for the Spring & Summer**_ **📱 _News You Can Use_ ** **Governor Mike Braun**** **[traveled](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-d/) to Northwest Indiana to review severe weather damage, meet with first responders, and receive a briefing at the Emergency Operations Center in Lake Village.**Lieutenant Governor Micah Beckwith** [highlighted](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-h/) the importance of free speech in strengthening civic life and empowering young Hoosiers to express their viewpoints. Beckwith also recognized the work of Turning Point USA and its Club America chapters across Indiana. **Secretary Diego Morales **[addressed](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-k/) Indiana county clerks at the Northern and Southern District Conferences, highlighting efforts to strengthen election integrity and support local election administrators. Morales also discussed recent legislative updates and preparations for the upcoming election cycle across the state.**Treasurer Daniel Elliott **[visited](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-b/) Falls of the Ohio State Park with the Indiana Bond Bank team to highlight efforts to provide low-cost funding that helps preserve Indiana's natural resources while saving taxpayer dollars.**Attorney General Todd Rokita **[visited](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-n/) Lake Village to support recovery efforts following a devastating tornado, helping connect residents with resources and information on avoiding storm-related scams. Rokita also thanked first responders, volunteers, and community members assisting with recovery efforts.**Senator Todd Young **[renewed](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-p/) his push on the _Student Protection and Success Act_ , bipartisan legislation to curb the mounting student debt crisis by increasing higher education institutions' accountability for their students' ability to repay their loans and requiring institutions to have a vested interest in the success of their students. **Senator Jim Banks**[celebrated](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-x/) the passage of his _Revitalizing Empty Structures Into Desirable Environments (RESIDE) Act_ passed in the United States Senate _.__ _ This bill would set aside funding within the Home Investment Partnerships Program (HOME) starting in 2026 for a new pilot program to help communities turn abandoned or run-down buildings--like warehouses, factories, hotels, strip malls, and other unused spaces--into new homes for families in Indiana. **Congressman Rudy Yakym **[introduced](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-m/) a resolution to honor the incredible life and legacy of Coach Lou Holtz, joined by Indiana Congressmen Jim Baird and Mark Messmer, saying, "Coach Holtz was a legend in every sense of the word, a national championship-winning coach, a bestselling author, a beloved media personality, and an inspiration to countless people around the world."**Congressman Marlin Stutzman **[highlighted](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-c/) federal funding secured for Northeast Indiana to support the Fort Wayne Police Department and City Utilities, helping ensure they have the resources needed to serve the community effectively.**Congressman Jim Baird **[introduced](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-q/) the _Bioindustrial Scale-Up for Supply Chains and Energy Resiliency Act of 2026_ to amend the _Energy Policy Act of 2005_ to direct the U.S. Secretary of Energy to establish at least two bioindustrial scale-up facilities in the United States. These facilities would accelerate the scaling of emerging bioindustrial technologies, including coordinating with other relevant facilities and federal agencies.**Congresswoman Victoria Spartz **[joined](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-a/) Donald Trump in recognizing Women's History Month and celebrating the contributions of American women throughout the nation's history.**Congressman Jefferson Shreve **[met](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-f/) with the Indiana Credit Union League in Washington to discuss expanding financial opportunities for Hoosiers in Indiana's 6th District. The meeting also focused on efforts to combat scams and support access to affordable financial services.**Congressman Mark Messmer **[met](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-z/) with members of the Indiana Broadcasters Association to discuss the importance of local news and connectivity for Hoosiers in Indiana's 8th District.**Congresswoman Erin Houchin** [introduced](https://indianarepublicancentralcommittee.cmail20.com/t/y-l-aihjjkk-hhlljjcji-e/) the bipartisan _POINTS Act_ , legislation aimed at expanding prevention, treatment, and recovery services for individuals experiencing gambling addiction. The bill would dedicate a portion of existing federal sports wagering tax revenue to support addiction programs nationwide. **_Upcoming Events_****March 20:[Indiana Republican Party 2026 Spring Peter,
The effort to redistrict Colorado is now officially underway but with that we have some good news and some bad news.
The good news: Yesterday, Colorado's Title Board approved (though we may still face legal changes) an initial measure to allow voters to decide on new congressional maps to fight back against Trump's fascist power grab by erasing 3 MAGA seats.
The bad news: unsurprisingly, a MAGA-backed, dark-money-funded group--Advance Colorado, with deep ties to extremists and even Russian oligarchs-- stepped in at the 11th hour with their own ballot initiative aimed at undercutting our efforts.

This drastically complicates what was initially a clearcut pathway to passing this redistrict.
Now not only do we need to collect the 200,000 signatures needed to get our initiative on the ballot but we now must mount a legal offensive to ensure that their counter-proposal does not reach the ballot where it could compete against ours and confuse voters.
If we can't nip their effort in the bud, and trust us our lawyers are doing their damndest to stop it - yesterday they fought tooth and nail at Title Board to oppose it, we will have to challenge every one of their 200k signatures, a painstaking process that will cost us millions.
And if that doesn't stop it we will ultimately have to prepare to campaign for voters to pass our redistricting and vote against theirs. A worst case scenario though by no means insurmountable.
We are prepared to aggressively tackle each of the above outcomes but suffice to say this endeavor just became astronomically more expensive. GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE

Friend,

Lent is not just a season.

It is a pilgrimage.

A journey led by the Holy Spirit… into the desert.

And the desert is not empty.
It is sacred.
It is where God reminds us who we are.

When Jesus entered the desert, He was tempted. He was tested.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D

But even then, one holy declaration still echoed from Heaven and did not change: “You are my beloved Son.”

That same Father speaks over you.

You are His beloved son.
His beloved daughter.

Before any label.
Before any denomination.

And so is every child.

Even the child who has been lured… kidnapped… sold.

You may not know me yet.

My name is Eduardo Verástegui.

I produced the film Sound of Freedom after meeting real-life rescuers who risk everything to save children from trafficking.

What I heard broke my heart.

Children treated like products.
Like profit.
Like they do not matter.

I asked myself,

“What if it were my child?”

That question changed my life. The film became a movement.
And the Sound of Freedom Foundation was born.

But the story did not end when the credits rolled.

Today, our foundation works to prevent trafficking before it begins.

We equip trusted partners who rescue children.
We educate families so they can protect their sons and daughters.
We advocate for laws that defend the innocent.

This is not politics.
It is protection.
It is faith in action.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D
Protect God’s Children Now

But if we are honest…

Our hearts can grow numb and we get distracted. We get comfortable.

Lent is a wake-up call.

A time for metanoia.
A turning back to God.

This Lenten season, pause and ask the Holy Spirit:

“What do You want to restore in me?”

Your prayer life?
Your courage?
Your tenderness toward the vulnerable?

Because when hearts grow cold…children suffer.

And today, many of God’s children are enslaved.

They are created in His image.
They belong to Him.
Their dignity is sacred.

When we forget that… the innocent pay the price.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D
Protect God’s Children Now

During Lent, I pray more intentionally.

I ask the Holy Spirit to strengthen us for this battle.

As a Catholic, I also ask for the prayers of the faithful who have gone before us.

I ask Our Lady of Guadalupe to intercede for these little ones.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D

I ask Saint Joseph to guard them.
I ask Saint Michael to defend them.

Not instead of God.

But asking them to pray with us… as one family in Christ.
Because this is spiritual warfare.

Light against darkness.

And Jesus was clear:

“Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.” (Matthew 25:40)

When we protect a child, we serve Christ.
When we rescue the vulnerable, we love Christ.

Friend, you may be hearing about this mission for the first time.

But maybe this is not an accident.

Maybe the Holy Spirit is inviting you into something deeper this Lent.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D
Protect God’s Children Now

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D

Let Him restore your heart.

And together, let us restore freedom to enslaved children of God.

This is not about one church.
It is about the Gospel.

It is about the truth that every human life has dignity because it comes from God.

So we say it boldly:

God’s children are not for sale.

Not in our nation. Not in our world.
Not ever.

Will you stand with us?

With gratitude and prayer,

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D

Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D

# District 46,
I was grateful to take a few extra moments this week to celebrate Indy on 317 Day.

We live in a beautiful, diverse community with world-class sports, entertainment, arts and culture all in our backyard. Our city can achieve these things because of the people who call it home. It is because of you all that boundless opportunities exist for District 46 to be a destination to live, work and play.

We will get another chance to showcase this on the national stage as **[Men's Final Four Fan Fest](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "Men's Final Four Fan Fest")** is just around the corner -- stay tuned to my social media for updates on events and other important information.

It is an honor to stand with you all in representing this great city.

In Service,

_State Senator Andrea Hunley _

# Free eviction sealing clinic
---
### Indiana Justice Project will host an eviction sealing clinic from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. on March 21 at North United Methodist Church, [3808 N. Meridian St.](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D)
You can meet with an attorney for free to see if your eviction cases can be sealed. In Indiana, an eviction can be sealed if:
* Your case was dismissed, or
* The case was decided in your favor, or
* The judgment against you was overturned, or
* You don't owe money, and it's been at least seven years since the case ended.

You can learn more about legal resources available to you by visiting [Indiana Legal Help](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "Indiana Legal Help").
* * *

|
---
### Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program
The Energy Assistance Program's (EAP) application is now live until**April 20, 2026**. You can apply [online ](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/www.in.gov/ihcda/homeowners-and-renters/low-income-home-energy-assistance-program-liheap/__;!!FlTQaCg!i0IlNmwztWy24u3OfjflEyvBopYLxqtX54ZBOGpkRIGHfA-g0F4tvn2RkRjwIClxVywwPaZ8QxM8BqUkhHdM0-IFVw$"), by mail or in person. To apply in person or request a paper application form, applicants must contact their local service provider (LSP). For more information on which LSP serves an area, be sure to check the map available on Indiana's [LIHEAP site](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/www.in.gov/ihcda/homeowners-and-renters/low-income-home-energy-assistance-program-liheap/__;!!FlTQaCg!i0IlNmwztWy24u3OfjflEyvBopYLxqtX54ZBOGpkRIGHfA-g0F4tvn2RkRjwIClxVywwPaZ8QxM8BqUkhHdM0-IFVw$").

In addition to this program, Indiana's utilities have financial assistance programs available, as well as other tools that can help customers manage their bills. You can find _[AES's program here](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://www.aesindiana.com/payment-assistance__;!!FlTQaCg!jwpfitqHKx4bP-5cnhYvoAX1m8Q0kv3P901-pv7dMHXQdpRgas_bRhhF66AOaSuHe8tMuc2p6moGi_XjArAanOEmX3Q$") [.](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/www.nipsco.com/bills-and-payments/financial-support__;!!FlTQaCg!i0IlNmwztWy24u3OfjflEyvBopYLxqtX54ZBOGpkRIGHfA-g0F4tvn2RkRjwIClxVywwPaZ8QxM8BqUkhHfV2_ol6Q$")_

As a reminder, the winter moratorium runs from December 1 through March 15 and prevents disconnection of residential energy utility service to any customer who is eligible for and has applied for the Energy Assistance Program. Moratorium protection applies once a household submits an application and allows the Local Service Provider time to determine eligibility.

Utility bills continue to rise, and what should be an essential service has become an overwhelming burden for many families. If you're eligible, please take advantage of the available resources so you don't have to choose between keeping food on the table and keeping the lights on.
* * *
---
# **Delta Dental Steps Up: Bringing Care to Underserved Hoosiers**
Nearly 1 million Hoosiers live in areas with too few dentists. Delta Dental of Indiana is stepping up with a new initiative to fix that -- and support the professionals who serve our most underserved communities.

Here's what's available:
* A loan repayment program to support private practice dentists in underserved communities (up to $40,000 per year, up to five years). At least 15% of the dentist's patients must be covered by Medicaid each year.
* A loan repayment program for dentists (up to $25,000 per year, up to three years) who commit to working in nonprofit clinics.
* A loan repayment program for dental hygienists (up to $5,000 per year, up to three years) who commit to working in nonprofit clinics.
* A scholarship program for dental hygiene students to cover the cost of attendance (up to $15,000 per year, up to two years).

This is how we build healthier communities -- by investing in care where it's needed most.

**Apply by March 31, 2026**
**[Learn more + apply here](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "Learn more + apply here")**
* * *

# Is Your Voter Registration Up to Date?

Did you know that as many as **one in four eligible Americans are not registered to vote?** And here in Indiana, we ranked 50th in voter participation during the last midterm election.

Friends, we can do better. Voting is one of our most sacred civic duties, and it is the most effective way to make your voice heard and help shape our democracy.

With 2026 right around the corner, now is the time to make sure your registration is up to date.

**Check your registration here TODAY:** **[indianavoters.in.gov](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https://l.facebook.com/l.php?u=https*3A*2F*2Findianavoters.in.gov*2F*3Ffbclid*3DIwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAYnJpZBExeVFKTXV0TVBqWnlDem5XOQEeo6iL-jt_GSc9VnJssLvEpdfoldXDv8wmi0Xk8JPAf5R-EGLehYqRQ5_8Ghc_aem_UW06gL0xH-NAbFV-rXbC0A&h=AT23Jhyf097GJAF0r9ntonfWZwJka7ceujKXIiY_GKYtL1Q6Y-jV2X0mbD4M2HkjL9BqGJsQy2B_j7PdSoAQ2eW7idfD3bTZIBLt9dZWYIz81dB2uuHPOK29CJBimCdvBEmxCDvCpQ_5FNjO&__tn__=-UK-R&c*5B0*5D=AT1erzsBSzocvWMrTFXawwVD6CxH4GDCNbd5Ln8FzW6w3SCgquOAiSFf07B6XLbBdgKApnjr39m_ny4aNvG4xHbarDwlQlY0mkPsIgbHrV_Ye80evR9Gmsx6deg2Fb78TSXNMqBscDumTG9r8pPfbhpXbbD4ue59ye7WPvs4K_KJQnvZ8TuUBht-KAscwJ7s3xMMEfrdRBjf3F_v-17edbMN2A__;JSUlJSUlJSU!!FlTQaCg!kVMTtyjJPlZ71IWfITOegcgB7_usPM7yG9dVqFMCRGg7XVU5p-uGnA8WAnuRnHfstiueL-pDsRtapey-zj6JWcnqOd4$")**

## Community Development Block Grants Now Open for Applications
---
The [Indiana Office of Community and Rural Affairs](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/click.subscription.in.gov/?*3D__;JQ!!FlTQaCg!jhKZrnu0wl_pCrnCW_0vDUonIoVGbRZf_4k8X6z2qLM77GkUX908AF_F8yrz0VxQuDPmJi0dcStoOf64sRlAK64CvV6CuGA$") announced the first round of [Community Development Block Grants](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/click.subscription.in.gov/?*3D__;JQ!!FlTQaCg!jhKZrnu0wl_pCrnCW_0vDUonIoVGbRZf_4k8X6z2qLM77GkUX908AF_F8yrz0VxQuDPmJi0dcStoOf64sRlAK64CuDH0djg$") for 2026 is now open for applications.

The following programs are accepting applications.

* Blight Clearance
* Main Street Revitalization
* Public Facilities
* Stormwater Improvements
* Wastewater/Drinking Water

Detailed information on 2026 Round 1 updates can be found on the [CDBG Resources page](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/click.subscription.in.gov/?*3D__;JQ!!FlTQaCg!jhKZrnu0wl_pCrnCW_0vDUonIoVGbRZf_4k8X6z2qLM77GkUX908AF_F8yrz0VxQuDPmJi0dcStoOf64sRlAK64CDJZZDHI$").

Proposal submissions will be collected via the electronic Grants Management System. Instructions on how to submit proposals can be found at [in.gov/ocra/cdbg/cdbg-construction-grants/](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/click.subscription.in.gov/?*3D__;JQ!!FlTQaCg!jhKZrnu0wl_pCrnCW_0vDUonIoVGbRZf_4k8X6z2qLM77GkUX908AF_F8yrz0VxQuDPmJi0dcStoOf64sRlAK64CAFWlOXc$").

2026 Round 1 proposals are due on Sunday, April 5, by 11:59 p.m. ET via [eGMS ](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/click.subscription.in.gov/?*3D__;JQ!!FlTQaCg!jhKZrnu0wl_pCrnCW_0vDUonIoVGbRZf_4k8X6z2qLM77GkUX908AF_F8yrz0VxQuDPmJi0dcStoOf64sRlAK64C3N4nGf8$"). Communities are encouraged to submit their proposals prior to 3 p.m. on April 3, as technical assistance will not be available after that time.

2026 Round 1 applications are due on Sunday, June 7, by 11:59 p.m. ET also via [eGMS ](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/click.subscription.in.gov/?*3D__;JQ!!FlTQaCg!jhKZrnu0wl_pCrnCW_0vDUonIoVGbRZf_4k8X6z2qLM77GkUX908AF_F8yrz0VxQuDPmJi0dcStoOf64sRlAK64Cr87dZE0$"). Applicants are encouraged to submit their applications prior to 3 p.m. on June 5, as technical assistance will not be available after that time.

**Important Notes:**

The deadline for in-kind request submission has **changed **to the proposal due date. Request for the use of in-kind match should be emailed to [cdbg@ocra.in.gov](mailto:cdbg@ocra.in.gov?subject=In-Kind%20Request%20Submission "mailto:cdbg@ocra.in.gov?subject=In-Kind%20Request%20Submission") no later than Sunday, April 5, at 11:59 p.m. ET. All requests are to be made in accordance with [CDBG Policy Notice 2025-005: In-Kind Contribution Policy ](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/click.subscription.in.gov/?*3D__;JQ!!FlTQaCg!jhKZrnu0wl_pCrnCW_0vDUonIoVGbRZf_4k8X6z2qLM77GkUX908AF_F8yrz0VxQuDPmJi0dcStoOf64sRlAK64CoXZCKvY$").

All income survey documentation should be submitted final approval in eGMS by the proposal due date. This change is to confirm the National Objective of Low-to-Moderate Income Area Benefit is being met by applicants using an income survey.

The deadline for all bonus point submissions has **changed **to the application due date. Request for bonus points should be uploaded with the application on eGMS no later than Sunday, June 7, at 11:59 p.m. ET.

Funding for all CDBG programs comes from the [U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development ](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/click.subscription.in.gov/?*3D__;JQ!!FlTQaCg!jhKZrnu0wl_pCrnCW_0vDUonIoVGbRZf_4k8X6z2qLM77GkUX908AF_F8yrz0VxQuDPmJi0dcStoOf64sRlAK64CpY2Eoj0$")and is administered by OCRA. The State of Indiana distributes CDBG funds to rural communities to assist units of local government with various community projects like improving infrastructure, downtown revitalization, public facilities improvements and economic development.

For further information on these programs, visit [in.gov/ocra/cdbg ](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/click.subscription.in.gov/?*3D__;JQ!!FlTQaCg!jhKZrnu0wl_pCrnCW_0vDUonIoVGbRZf_4k8X6z2qLM77GkUX908AF_F8yrz0VxQuDPmJi0dcStoOf64sRlAK64C-XxG_54$") or contact the assigned OCRA regional [community liaison](https://click.subscription.in.gov/?%3D "https://urldefense.com/v3/__https:/click.subscription.in.gov/?*3D__;JQ!!FlTQaCg!jhKZrnu0wl_pCrnCW_0vDUonIoVGbRZf_4k8X6z2qLM77GkUX908AF_F8yrz0VxQuDPmJi0dcStoOf64sRlAK64CaN9sO7U$").

## White House Unveils National AI Plan
The Trump administration on Friday released a [national framework for regulating artificial intelligence](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OgzAQBOCnMR3IP8ROChfX0OXaK9FmWYe9GBsZJyhvfyKvcN1II30jzc91vAJHTvdvWMjXkMdE-xapVipjgso5QQReIyScn_hIuRTeRi21baVptRon4Pge-2bygUiTacgr53p5dtbqZvY9amUsGkBjJ4VGOTyjgpPE20XBKTTsD00arZSUzpw7cBQuwfUBwU5wuYle0sQ1l-43c6ozhfjOLyod5qWJfq513YT5EnoQetj3vcN0w6MUejhooQdpPlnooZbnsrbA7Zoj47sNBRbac3l0c11iU_y07hwjb9aJXt4X4PjZqf865-X1XwAAAP__rOd4QQ), seeking to centralize a single policy in Washington by preempting state-level AI laws it says will hamper innovation. The framework outlines six key objectives prioritizing innovation and scaling AI, proposing a federal approach that would [override stricter state regulations](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOgzAQRL8GOiJjGxwKF9fQ5dor0YLXeC-LjYyTKH9_Ir9w5cxIT5r3c5tuQExx_YYNbfFpivg6GEvBPEUolCIw0M4Ql_BY7jHlTMckhewboRrZTg6I35OunfWIElWNtjVGi6vpe1kHK3oE33k3D6jaeZi175T23qHyQsp5qMmeNKFk2wph1PUCBv3gjfYL9A6GudICHZWUL7-JYgno-Z2emC9L2mq2oZT9qNRXJcdKjiVgIOZzq-S4J6blfda4hJg4rWfozKBa0TVATcb1wZ-bjc-w4SvleyXHOlu3v4iZjt5UWqwb0IdZl39Jelr5FwAA___w4nzo) on issues ranging from children's online safety to free speech protections and streamlined AI infrastructure. On child safety, the framework [calls for parental controls](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAUhJ8Gd0QY_FtQbOMu225pncAhsMFgwXGsvP2V8wq3G2lGn0bfv_t6hxBDev6FDTW5vCY8a0QiLGsCCjlBhLBHSMYf5pVyKaGuUsiBC8Vlu1oI8bN2jdUOUaJqULfj2IlpHAbZeK3mVvTzA_upU1bMgwW06HplcO6mHmQT9EUTSratEKOabjCim93YOQODhfnBOoE2UC63_zkk8ujiJ7-x3Ezemqg90V6Z-sPkwuRCaLwpRzL-qplcLjiTi1DffC3Kse2VQ-CuwIZnLi9OUJ5IlVcCQh7hrLz64Khy40O0vIJD-vDHUSwmTpnvUDBRZXJpirb7GWIMdRhZJ54bhPi9Rr_y-dbyJwAA__8Q5YuN) while stopping short of enforceable requirements for AI companies. It also addresses intellectual property rights and rules against AI-driven censorship of political expression. Critics argue the framework shields Big Tech from accountability, while industry supporters say a uniform national standard is exactly what startups need.
## CBS Closing Century-Old News Radio Service
CBS News announced Friday that it is [shutting down CBS News Radio](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOtCAURp9GOwwCAS0o_sZu_nZLc4XreHcZmACO8e037s4bbHeSk9zc833c5htQoHj_Dw-0dU1zxKMErBXzHKFSihCAngGi23b3FVPOVGbBhWZcMtHPHiics2q9XREFyhZtb4zig9FatJvVYPyICoXspVnEuBqntOxxQC29HFRL9rrGpeh7zo0cOjC4jqtRqwPtYVwaxdFTTbn7TBTrhms40wtz59KjDXar9Vka-a8RUyOm4zi6uLir4vKNmC5sxLQX9ia3_CIr2351FlZqyoSeZfCU3g7zixyyiJDDyRzGuueTYfQU7wwzsOwiCK2U4W22_nlQCFS0aRS_P4DCz3f1T5O-rPgOAAD__8iMjgc), ending a historic broadcast service that has been on the air since 1927 and once carried Edward R. Murrow's World War II dispatches from London. Today CBS News Radio provides material to an estimated 700 radio stations across the country, and is known best for its top-of-the-hour news roundups. The service will end on May 22, the network said Friday. The closure comes alongside layoffs of approximately 6% of the CBS News workforce, [roughly 60 to 70 employees](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u4yAUhJ8Gd47wgfBTUGxDl223tI7tQ8wugQhYR377K99XuN1II32j-f485gfGFPPzN77I9VDmTJ-WqHeqc8YeS8aE8Z0wr_v_9V8utcY2Awc1cjHCNG8Y0znLYXOBCEgM5CatJTdaKRh2xy0uAekOxgqBZJe7BSNw5ZvRwko9RHfRuIBp4lwLc0NNwQYtw4pqQ7swyWmLvdTb3xJz3ymksxxUb2t5Dcntvb8bE78YeAb-wBqpn1fHwF9kBr4fDPx1jIFflzZecUx4lhDaqMbWMYRxAqGUlcZYBn6obnt_YkqxKc0kf74wpu_B_iNLh4OvAAAA__9icXnE), according to Editor-in-Chief Bari Weiss and President Tom Cibrowski. The executives cited a shifting news landscape and the need to reach younger, digitally focused audiences. They called the radio closure a necessary but difficult decision driven by changing radio programming strategies.
## Action Icon Chuck Norris Dies
Chuck Norris, the iconic martial artist and action star best known for _Walker, Texas Ranger, _[died on Thursday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFuwyAQBuCnsTcsjIkhA0MXb-na0brAEV-LIcLXuHn7yukjdLrhpP_X939c5gtQonx7hxUdxzJn3LeEzFjnDEwlQwK6J8h--fZfudRK26ykGoUchOrnAJSes26Di4gKhxZdb4yW1oyjahcnjQZt5XCyMlrwvY8KrzbgSdnoZd-35I40Oai-l9IMtgOD8RyNjh7GAOdroyUG4lK7z0KZF4zpWR5YO1_WNrmF-b41w1ujpkZN-753sfwciuPfqAkzY2WgvGLmRk3guVSxQmWCJI6zsXjhxJ9OBIQg7NhWF-47pUTbaBotbytQepXyv5Z6OPUbAAD__5NRf84) at the age of 86. Norris had been hospitalized in Hawaii shortly before his death, though earlier reports indicated he had been alert and in good spirits. He had been training as recently as March 18 and celebrated his 86th birthday on March 10 [with a boxing video](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DFuwyAUgOHT4C0WfhCwB4ZKrZcqHSJVHa1n84hpCURAYvn2VXqFzr_0Df_XaTqhDz5ePvBKpro0RdpKoFopTxGrTxED-lvAuKz35SemnH2ZgIM6cHGAbrLowz7JxhpHBCQaMp3WkvdaKWhWo_qjHOwstQQlxIwktLV6wN7C4vpj13jz1LiAruNci75FTW5wWroFlcVhZpKT9TXl9jv5WFdyYU8Pyu2Srk0wa623wsQLg5HBuG1bu6d7vc_07AzGsqZcC4Oxez_Xz_VVnS9vTTb2tvkQfFGaSX65og9_Xv3XhIeB3wAAAP__abBxCQ). Born Carlos Ray Norris in Oklahoma in 1940, he served in the U.S. Air Force, where he began [studying martial arts in South Korea](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2SozAQhJ8GMlH6wRIECi5x5ksvpMZoZOYsSxQam_I-_RbeR9isg66u7-t_l-kClCjf_sIDPccyZdxrQmbcpgxMJUMCWhPkeXnO91y2jeqkpbZCGqHVFIDSe-rb4COiRtOiV871cnDW6nbxZo52PBkLyspR6avRGEJ0A9gRdbCyJX-sSaOVktKZoQOHcYyujzPYAOO16SUG4rJ1_wtlXjCmd3nh1s3l0Sa_MK-1MX8afW70ed_37lDYEe9HodHnD7j4IReBsApgMVgBkXET9RkCZrGUuhJDoq-PtEjAWFk813AEoZSTp1Gf2s2HdaeUqFrX9PL2AEofEP7Vey-vvwMAAP__W8eGDw). ## _Walker, Texas Ranger_ Star Chuck Norris Dies
Martial artist and action hero [Chuck Norris](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOgzAMhp8GtiDHhECHDLew9dYbUSCmRE2TyqSlfftTeo9w8mLrk2x__895OlsffLx82xuZ_FrTFOnYA-VMPC3bY7nGxOx352lfUnArp5h5QkAtoBUoJ2d9eE-qdmYGd5I1Gdn3Ck6l6s1oOWicu14BkrJSAUjXa2gH0HJGp2pvyjJoUUoJUukGux7WuessUd8CzJUCcj4nbvJGmV52X8M7PYmbJd3qYLac73vVflU4Vjgex9HEeSkWhVc4lrbCMc0-Pyx7KsPHTPypieImBi3skn2KYiNO4rDhSiw-5wTbeCEuPLHgJVrEbmjbmo27Hz4Ev-u-UnC5WR8-T-X_Rfk0-BsAAP__sJ2JLw), beloved in Texas for his lead role in the TV show _Walker, Texas Ranger_ , passed away Thursday at the age 86, according to a statement from his family. Norris was deployed to South Korea while in the U.S. Air Force, where he learned Korean martial arts before rising to prominence in competitive martial arts in the U.S. He then starred in a series of [action movies](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOwyAQRL8Gd1iwYOMUFNe4y7VXWtgsMQox0ZoLyd-f4nzCaaWtRjPz5uc8nV1Mcbt8uxva8gx52rDuCUtBmpb1d7lumSjuPuK-5OQD5a3QBAJ6LhQHOXkX02vSjbez8CfZoJXGaHF6X7PaThitcMahD26Y1TyceiedckErGTQOTbRvM6FASimk7lvojAhz1zlEo4SYmRboY8nUlhULPt0e0is_kNol35pk11LuO1NfDEYGY621XXNKr5qzJ7xnKh8lg7E8jsffiAzGA49_-LhH53l16YrEjxBObrsgcQmq7zRAZxiMDVl_rzGluPeGaXG5uZiOHuV_6z0s_AUAAP__NqaFEg), including _The Way of the Dragon_ (along with Bruce Lee) and _The Delta Force_. Norris used his platform to promote Christian ideals and conservative political movements and candidates. Among the tributes to Norris' life was Texas Gov. Greg Abbott saying,_ "Texas has [lost a legend](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOgzAQRU8DHWg8NiYULrahy7ZbIoPHwVqDI3sSktuvyBVW04z0pff1_s91utoQw377thsZfvk07XSUSMyUp2V9LL97yjkUF6gsKTqf0855QkDdgGxQTM6G-J5U7cwMbhA1GdH3Cobz6tVoWAT4ThEOfvZCywGw03SR5BT26OpgThhIFEKAULrFrgc_d50l6iXAXCkgFzjllldietni4zs9KbdL2upoVuZ7qeRXhWOF43Ec7duuKZ1pheOpU-FoM4cl0vl-EE1MhZtIN9pdwznMD6bSfIQb0SmUFwG6XXmLdTbufoQYQ9F9peC22RA_1fy_wZ4G_wIAAP__wO1_9g)," _and adding that he _" electrified generations of conservatives."_
## New Confession May Impact Looming Execution
A Texas inmate has confessed to the murders for which his cousin, James Broadnax, is scheduled to be [executed](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGupCAURL8Gd5gLojwXLGbj7s12lga415YMQgew7f77ifMLL7U8SaXq_Plev22IIT1-24NMe295TXTVSK1RWf1--r8plxIqBqo-R9xKTq2sEuTEYeBSrGhD_KyqQ-MAZ9GREVormO90uxHKKgBUoAc3WW0duI3sqAePckSNXTB3GQxSCAFCTb0cNWxuHC2RHgAcU0AYWi5926nR29YtfvKLSu_z0UWzt_asbPjF5MLkcl1Xn5zH7boxk8v9h8klZm8jkwu9yZ8t5MTRNuIx56PyRBf3OW1U600etkSbkGM-XSR-nAWpMLkM8_w1fykml64YfF4hxlAnzRQ8Dhvi_z3tZxZfRv4LAAD__22QiDM) on April 30. Demarius Cummings, serving a life sentence for the same 2008 double murder, said in a statement that _" I was the one who shot the two victims, not James,"_ as he seeks to stop Broadnax's execution. Broadnax's attorneys are demanding a new trial after Cummings' confession, saying his statements align with evidence presented at trial. In his statement released Thursday, Cummings took [full responsibility](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSrCAURL8GMy24oowBwUvM5qUbWle4juwiWMCMzt9vOb-w1WnXqe7zdZ_u6LwLj_-4kS7nEqdAR_ZUCqXJrE_zE2JKLltH2URvlxRDSRNw6Gve1iAmi86_J1lZPXM7iIq0UEry4Uq16kUKaaUduBlM3wMJteCtm4VC6nknReX0BeMtCCG4kH0DneLL3HVIpFrOZyY5WVdiaspKhU7Mi3_HF6XGxK3yei1lz6z9x2BkMB7H0WzvjAFDicHFq8RgvF4xGH006BmMmIoznhiMH2BNJ5lncTHU37hRrucU0QY8awB-U23bNvu6V0nb_XDeu9wrJvljQ-c_I8rf1L00_AYAAP__Sp2EEA) for the planned robbery and the shooting of Stephen Swan and Matthew Butler, who were Christian music producers.
## Texas Remains in Top 15 Most Innovative States
Texas is holding its spot among the [15 most innovative](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGOtCAQhJ8GbxpAlHjg8F-8zX_do2mhGckiTKB1Zt5-4yT7BJu-dSr1VdXXbblBiCHd_8OOhl4-LwmfNSIRlsVuh_1OuZRQXcBqc3S-5ERlkVyOLe9bKRYHIb4X1TizcjeJBo3QWvHpumYzK6BAj1qOnKMF71HjMAqrxknh6qcmmMuM91IIwYUaOzlo7tdhAETdc74yxdEFyqWjDQlfUH185xNLZ_PeRLMRPSrr_zE5Mzk7iBFqZ49IR8EdHpeKyfmqxeQcUsonUMiJyXnPldrfz4ltJSCs7YfRXqmYnJti3OMZYgx11Ezx-w4hfsj0t71OI38CAAD__yl6gds) states in the U.S., according to an annual ranking from WalletHub. Texas is particularly focused on the semiconductor industry as it continues growing its footprint in the technology sector. ### Texas Homeowners Are Leaving $1.2 Billion on the Table
