| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Matt Ridley in Mississippi
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/msmomentum-12852584?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| _**If you're not in front of our Saturday email, you're behind.**_
---
| Dear Friend,
This week, MCPP hosted British author and science writer Matt Ridley for a special lunch event in Jackson. We’re still buzzing from the insights he shared.

Matt's talk was optimistic, grounded in history and data, and really drove home why free markets, innovation, and abundant energy are so crucial for human progress.
---
|
---
_Matt Ridley speaks in Mississippi_
| He started by reminding us how human prosperity really works - it's not top-down planning from governments, but bottom-up from people trading, specializing, and exchanging ideas. Think Adam Smith's _Wealth of Nations_(from way back in 1776).

Matt then zeroed in on energy as the real game-changer. Cheap energy fueled the Industrial Revolution and skyrocketing living standards, not empires or heavy government intervention.
---
|
---
_Great people, great conversations_
| The numbers on global progress are staggering. Matt made the point how in his lifetime, extreme poverty has dropped from about 50% to 8%, child mortality from 15% to 3%, and on average, we've added roughly seven extra hours of life per day for people around the world.

Cheap energy is the key, and without cheap energy today, Matt made the point that his native Britain is now struggling economically, overtaken by Mississippi in terms of output per person. Energy costs there are 3 - 4 times higher than in the U.S., thanks to policies that restrict oil and gas drilling, ban shale gas development and push heavily on intermittent renewables like wind and solar.
---
|
---
_Bill Cork of the Mississippi Development Authority_
| Matt praised the U.S. shale revolution - driven by entrepreneurs like Chris Wright, the Energy Secretary in the Trump administration.

America now produces more oil than Saudi Arabia. That cheap, abundant energy is powering chemicals, manufacturing, AI, data centers, and growth - including right here in Mississippi.
We must ensure plentiful energy in our state in order to prosper.

Cheaper energy, Matt suggested, actually leads to more use and more progress (the Jevons paradox). Britain - and everyone - should take a page from the U.S. and Mississippi: revive the spirit of Adam Smith and James Watt, deregulate where it makes sense and embrace genuine economic freedom.

We're grateful to everyone who joined us. As always, thank you for standing with us at the Mississippi Center for Public Policy as we work to promote freedom, prosperity, and sound policy here in our state.
---
|
---
_MCPP lunches are the most sociable events ever! _

---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

#
Every American should be absolutely disgusted by this, Peter.
First off, Trump started a war on his own. He didn’t justify it, he hasn’t gotten congressional approval for it, and he didn’t build a coalition of allies for it.
Then, Americans started getting killed. Allies across the region were attacked. The Strait of Hormuz was shut down, markets fell, and gas prices spiked.
Now, Trump and Hegseth are trying to use the fallen as a shield for their own failures. Trump is fundraising using images from the dignified transfer of our war dead. Hegseth is making up stories about families of the fallen telling him to “finish the job,” when no such thing happened.
**Worst of all, they’ve asked for another $200 billion dollars and haven’t ruled out sending American troops into combat.**
We haven’t seen anything like this since the height of the war in Iraq, but there’s one big difference. It took years for Iraq to spiral out of control, and Trump managed to completely botch this in days.
What comes next is going to make all the difference.
VoteVets is fighting it out on Capitol Hill to limit Trump’s ability to escalate this war, and whipping votes against funding for it. We’re reaching out to Veterans every day to build a coalition against Trump. And we’re readying millions of dollars to defeat every Republican who lets Trump put American troops in harm’s way.

Peter,
In less than a month, Wisconsin will elect a new state supreme court justice. As someone who grew up in the Badger State, the outcome of this race is personal for me.
Let’s rewind for a moment so I can explain why.
In 2011, just months after taking office, newly elected conservatives jumped at the chance to manipulate the state’s legislative maps.
**I spent three weeks sleeping on the cold marble floor in the state capitol building with 100,000 other concerned citizens to protest this and other power grabs they tried to push.**
Despite our efforts, anti-democracy forces went forward with their plan. They gutted the state’s nonpartisan elections board and enacted a horrifying gerrymander, guaranteeing them an unearned lock on power for a decade.
**Our movement was born out of moments like this, Peter. subject: My new challenger was an ICE prosecutor
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Justice Democrats
body:
This is a major development
#
Peter, we just learned that a former prosecutor for ICE is launching a campaign to run against me here in Minneapolis.
**[This is a major development in the race, and I’m asking you to stand with our campaign today by splitting a $5 contribution between me and Justice Democrats.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260321-io.bPqMi-&refcode=em20260321-37587&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=2&akid=37587%2E1203867%2EOhT8MW)**
**[RUSH $5 HERE](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260321-io.bPqMi-&refcode=em20260321-37587&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=3&akid=37587%2E1203867%2EOhT8MW)**
Peter, I probably don’t have to tell you that Minneapolis has had enough of ICE.
Trump’s lawless band of thugs surged into our state and our city, stomped all over our civil rights, racially profiled our communities, brutalized and harassed countless Minnesotans, and murdered two of my constituents in cold blood.
But we fought back. We successfully pushed for Kristi Noem to get fired, we ended the ICE surge, and we continue to push to seek accountability for ICE violence and to abolish this corrupt agency for good. In fact, I’ve been calling for ICE to be abolished since Trump’s first term.
My new challenger can’t say the same. They signed up to be a prosecutor for ICE in **April 2025** , when Trump’s disastrous and inhumane mass deportation agenda was well underway. They even went so far as to say they were **“proud” to work for ICE.**
We already have a hugely important FEC fundraising deadline at the end of the month. **Now the stakes are even higher.** We don’t know if this challenger will receive the backing of corporate PACs, establishment mega-donors, or even AIPAC. We have to be ready for anything.
**[Please: Chip in $5 today — split between me and Justice Democrats — and join our grassroots movement. I’m calling on progressives in Minneapolis and around the country to help supercharge our campaign and make sure we can beat this challenger and any other that comes our way.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260321-io.bPqMi-&refcode=em20260321-37587&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=4&akid=37587%2E1203867%2EOhT8MW)**
**[Contribute $5](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260321-io.bPqMi-&refcode=em20260321-37587&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=23&akid=37587%2E1203867%2EOhT8MW)**
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

The clock is ticking, and we have no time to waste.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260321-369&t=1&akid=369%2E12592%2EZASPFk)
As of today, **we are officially one month out from Election Day on April 21**.
Here’s where we’re at: _early voting is already underway._ That means decisions are being made right now about the future of fair elections in Virginia. Not next week. Not next month. **Today**.
While we are working to reach voters across the Commonwealth, MAGA politicians and their allies are already spreading misinformation and trying to confuse voters before all the ballots are cast. They know that if people have the facts, they will choose the YES campaign for redistricting.
**_That is why this moment matters so much._**
Virginians for Fair Elections is in the middle of a full-scale effort to meet voters where they are. That means educating communities, cutting through the noise, and making sure every voter understands what is at stake before they cast their ballot.
_But we are up against the clock._ With early voting already in motion, we cannot afford to fall behind even for a day.
[**Can you rush a donation right now to help us reach voters before more ballots are cast?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260321_1.SrYdca&amount=3&refcode=20260321-369&t=2&akid=369%2E12592%2EZASPFk)
**[Donate $3 ››](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260321_1.SrYdca&amount=3&refcode=20260321-369&t=21&akid=369%2E12592%2EZASPFk)**

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

| | Friends,
I want to remind you that I was the last major candidate to enter the Attorney General's race on either side of the aisle.
Despite that, I've earned the endorsement of 63 County Prosecutors, 30 sheriffs, the Police Officers Association of Michigan, and former Attorney General Bill Schuette. They support me because they know I put the law, justice, and victims above ego and politics.
Meanwhile, my Republican opponent continues to demonstrate why he lacks support from law enforcement across Michigan. A recent robocall connected to individuals supporting his campaign has raised serious questions about its origin and legality, and has caused significant concern within the law enforcement community, to the point that prosecutors have felt the need to speak out.
Please take a moment to read this letter from Menominee County Prosecutor Jeff Rogg.
Doug Lloyd Eaton County Prosecuting Attorney Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

null,

**It’s Catherine Cortez Masto, and I know what it takes to win in a battleground state.**

I’ve done it here in Nevada – and I know Haley Stevens can do it in Michigan.
**That’s one of the reasons I’m proud to endorse Haley for the U.S. Senate.**

[**I hope you’ll consider joining me in supporting her by chipping in to her campaign today.**](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/15923?t=3&akid=2534%2E49239%2EvtHDyB)

Haley is exactly the kind of leader we need in this moment: principled, smart, hardworking, and deeply committed to the people of Michigan.

As women in politics, Haley and I both know the path is never easy. We’ve been underestimated. We’ve been tested. We’ve fought tough races.
But that’s also what makes Haley Stevens so strong.

**She helped save 200,000 Michigan jobs as the Chief of Staff on President Obama's Auto Rescue. In Congress, she's fought to lower costs for working families, and she’s been a relentless champion for manufacturing, for labor, and for communities too often overlooked by the people in power.**
And she’s done it all with grit, integrity, and a clear sense of who she’s fighting for.

That matters.

Because Michigan is one of the most important races in the country. Senate control could come down to Michigan, and **Democrats need a candidate who can win.**

That’s Haley. Polling shows she is the strongest Democrat to take on Trump-endorsed Mike Rogers, and she’s especially strong with independents – a critical group in a battleground state like Michigan.
Haley has the strength, the record, and the doggedness to keep Michigan blue – and I’m proud to stand with her.

**[If you’re with Haley too, I hope you’ll support her campaign today by chipping in $5, or whatever you can, to help her win this race and help Democrats take back the Senate.](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/15923?t=4&akid=2534%2E49239%2EvtHDyB)**

name: Deb Haaland
subject: the newest member of my family
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
I'm so excited to introduce you to the newest member of my family and of the Team Haaland pack

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=8351%2E400544%2ErCuUSd)
---
Hi, friend, it's Deb, and I'm so excited to introduce you to the newest member of my family and of the Team Haaland pack: **Zia**!
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk430-fr-nd&t=2&akid=8351%2E400544%2ErCuUSd)
I rescued her and named her after the iconic Zia sun — an emblem New Mexicans are proud of and one you can find everywhere in our state, from our state flag and license plates to my own campaign logo.
The Zia sun is a sacred symbol to the Indigenous people of Zia Pueblo. It holds deep beauty and significance for our state, for our people, and for me. It also reflects something special about New Mexico — the way we look out for one another and care for our communities.

As someone who comes from 35 generations of Laguna Pueblo women, that spirit guides how I live, how I lead, and how I’m running this campaign — because I want to make sure every New Mexican has the chance to thrive.
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk430-fr-nd&t=3&akid=8351%2E400544%2ErCuUSd)
---
I have never forgotten my roots, friend, and I never will.

I was once a single mom living paycheck to paycheck, relying on programs like SNAP, WIC, and Medicaid to help keep my child fed and healthy. That’s when I knew I wanted to make sure government and our leaders worked for the people — not the other way around.

So I became an organizer, then chair of the Democratic Party of New Mexico, one of the first Native women elected to Congress, and later the first Native Cabinet secretary.

Every step of the way, I’ve stayed true to who I’ve always been: a fighter and a protector for New Mexicans.

And that will never change.
I am ready to fight for higher wages, lower costs, safer neighborhoods, and strong education for your children. I am ready to push back when Trump wants to drag his dangerous, extremist ideas to New Mexico. I am ready to be the governor New Mexico needs.

But I can’t do it alone. That’s why I have an incredible campaign team, it’s why I have Zia, and friend, it’s why I am reaching out to you. I don't have the means to self-fund my campaign like many of my opponents do, but I do have tens of thousands of folks like you who believe that New Mexico needs a governor who will fight fiercely for our home and our people.
_[Our average online donation this month is just $24.32.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/6414?refcode=jtk430-fr-nd&t=4&akid=8351%2E400544%2ErCuUSd)_ That means this campaign is powered by a steady stream of people-powered support that allows us to build momentum across our beautiful state and win.
**So on this special day, as we welcome Zia to our family and this grassroots team, I am humbly asking:_[Will you please chip in $24.32 or anything you can today to support our campaign?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/6414?refcode=jtk430-fr-nd&t=5&akid=8351%2E400544%2ErCuUSd)_**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/5902?refcode=jtk430-fr-nd&t=6&akid=8351%2E400544%2ErCuUSd)
---
Be Fierce,

Deb

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

The reason I'm running for Congress
| | | | |
---
| Russ Cleveland Candidate for U.S. House, MT-01
Small Business Owner • Dad • Coach • Navy Veteran
---
|
Hi Friend,
This campaign started in a hospital room. It's the reason I'm running for Congress.
My name is Russ Cleveland.
I grew up in the Bitterroot Valley in western Montana. I'm a small business owner who built a childcare company, a coach, a husband, a dad, and a Navy veteran.
Today, I'm running for Congress in Montana's First District.
But the decision to run didn't come from a political party or a back office in Washington.
It came in January 2025, when one of the first actions of the Trump administration was to cut funding for pediatric cancer research.
That hit home.
Because almost six years ago, my wife Kate and I sat beside our thirteen-year-old daughter Madison as she fought an unexpected battle with leukemia.
And then we watched her take her last breath.
---
|
---
| While she was fighting for her life, we were also fighting insurance companies. Endless paperwork. Bills that reached $300,000 in a single month.
In that hospital room, I learned something quickly.
The system isn't built for families like ours.
We don't have lobbyists. We don't have PACs writing checks.
All we have is one vote.
Too often that voice gets drowned out by dark money and special interests calling the shots.
So I chose a different path.
This campaign is powered entirely by individual contributions; no corporate PAC money, no dark money, no special interests.
Because when I get to Washington, I want to owe no one but the people of Montana.
For nearly a year now, I've been traveling across western Montana, showing up in communities big and small and listening to the people who live here.
And something powerful is happening.
We're building the coalition it takes to win this race and flip this seat from red to blue.
If this story speaks to you, please chip in whatever you can today to help us win this primary and in November.

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

For years, Connecticut has been moving in the wrong direction.
High taxes. Endless traffic. Crumbling infrastructure. Sky-high energy costs. Overregulation. Weak workforce pipelines. Fewer opportunities. A shrinking middle class.
This is not what Connecticut used to be--and it's not what it has to be.
### **What Went Wrong?**
Connecticut has become one of the most expensive states to live in, yet residents are getting less in return.
* Taxes keep rising while fiscal problems remain
* Government keeps growing while accountability shrinks
* Businesses are leaving--or choosing not to come at all
* Young people can't afford to stay

We are overtaxed, overregulated, and underperforming.
### **You See It Every Day**
You feel it in traffic on I-95, the Merritt, and I-84--where congestion is constant and getting worse.
You see it in deteriorating roads and delayed infrastructure projects that never seem to catch up.
And you see it in your electric bill--where hidden charges like the **Public Benefits Charge** drive costs higher without transparency or results.
### **Bad Energy Policy = Higher Costs**
Connecticut's energy policy is making life less affordable.
Instead of building reliable, scalable power, the state has layered mandates, fees, and restrictions onto the system.
The result:
* Some of the highest electric bills in the country
* Hidden taxes through charges like the Public Benefits Charge
* No serious plan to meet rising demand

We are paying more--and getting less.
### **A Broken Workforce Pipeline**
At the same time, Connecticut is failing to prepare its workforce.
We have job openings in trades, construction, manufacturing, and skilled industries--but no coordinated, scalable training pipeline to meet demand.
Instead of aligning education with real jobs:
* Young people graduate without pathways to opportunity
* Employers struggle to find qualified workers
* Economic growth is held back

This is a failure of planning--and a failure of priorities.
### **The Middle Class Is Being Squeezed Out**
High taxes. High housing costs. Rising energy bills. Regulatory burdens.
All of it is pushing the middle class out of Connecticut.
Families are struggling to stay. Young people are leaving. Opportunity is shrinking.
### **A Housing Crisis of Our Own Making**
Instead of promoting homeownership, Connecticut continues to push top-down "affordable housing" mandates focused on rentals.
More regulation. More cost. Less ownership.
We need to make it easier--not harder--to build and own homes.
### **Erosion of Rights and Accountability**
Residents are seeing a steady erosion of control over their own lives:
* Parental rights in education are being challenged
* Property rights are being weakened through zoning mandates
* Regulations increasingly dictate how you live, build, and even manage your property

At the same time, concerns about political favoritism and insider-driven decisions continue to grow.
### **Failure to Plan for the Future**
From energy to infrastructure to workforce development--Connecticut is not planning ahead.
Demand is rising. Costs are rising. But long-term solutions are nowhere to be found.
Instead, the burden keeps getting pushed onto residents.
### **The Bottom Line**
Connecticut didn't fall behind overnight--but it is falling behind.
This is not decline by accident. It is the result of years of bad policy and lack of accountability.
### **A Better Direction**
We can change course:
* Lower taxes and responsible spending
* Fix roads and invest in real infrastructure
* Build a true workforce training pipeline tied to real jobs
* Deliver reliable, affordable energy--not hidden fees
* Promote homeownership and economic opportunity
* Restore accountability and balance in government

### **A Call to Action**
It's time to take Connecticut out of the third world.
That means restoring balance, ending one-party control, and putting the focus back where it belongs--on the people.
Connecticut can be a place of opportunity again.
But only if we choose to fix it--now.

body:
News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong.
| | | | |
---
| Letter from the Chair
---
Fellow Republicans,
I've had a very difficult time focusing on politics this week. With record-breaking wildfires in Central and Western Nebraska, my mind constantly goes to those who are suffering the loss of home, livestock, feed, and grassland. My mind also goes to the first responders - our law enforcement, firefighters, and medical personnel - who show up to work when needed despite their own personal obligations and risks to their property.
Many of us who live in rural areas rely on volunteer firefighters. The volunteer fire departments struggle for funding for equipment, maintenance, and training. Let's take some time in the upcoming weeks to show some appreciation to our volunteers by donating to them with a note of thanks.
Tragically one person has lost her life to the wildfires so far, but thanks be to God that there wasn't more loss of human life. As becoming Nebraskans, many fire departments and volunteers have shown up to fight the fires and serve the communities. As I write this, the fires are becoming more contained as time passes and winds subside. Let's continue to pray that we stay on this trajectory.
Ironically while the wildfires were building, eastern parts of the state suffered high winds and blizzard conditions last weekend that resulted in two deaths and we keep their families in prayer. None of us knows what the day will bring.
As a result of dangerous roads and low visibility, Wayne County Republicans had to reschedule their county convention from last Sunday to Friday April 10th. The NEGOP will keep an eye on other county conventions if they must be rescheduled.

| >From the Office of Attorney General Mike Hilgers...
One of my most important jobs as your Attorney General is protecting our election process. As Attorney General, we have achieved a number of felony convictions tied to election misconduct, and just last month we obtained a 23-count conviction of official misconduct tied to the recent marijuana petition efforts. An important part of keeping our elections fair is ensuring that they are decided by the people who actually live here--not outsiders halfway around the world. That's why we filed a major lawsuit last November to stop a far-left Swiss billionaire from secretly pouring foreign money into our ballot measures. Here's what's happening. A man named Hansjorg Wyss, worth billions and living in Switzerland, has sent more than $10 million into Nebraska to secretly fund ballot initiatives. He didn't write checks directly to ballot campaigns. Instead, the money traveled through a web of national nonprofits--groups with names most Nebraskans have never heard--before landing in local committees pushing big changes to our laws. This amount of money is enormous, and very difficult to fight here in Nebraska. Just last election cycle, he helped fund measures on paid sick leave, medical marijuana, and abortion. We investigated and revealed the money trail: Wyss sent money to his foundations, which sent money to national dark-money groups, and eventually straight into the ballot committees. All of it violates a simple Nebraska law we passed in 2022 when I served as Speaker of the Legislature: foreign nationals are not allowed to spend money on ballot questions. This matters to every family in Lincoln, every farmer in the Sandhills, and every small-business owner in Scottsbluff. Our state constitution and our way of life should be shaped by Nebraskans who understand our values, our challenges, and our communities. Not by a foreign billionaire who will never set foot in our state or feel the consequences of the changes he's trying to buy. That's why we acted. My office followed the money, documented every step, and sued Wyss and the six main groups in Madison County. We're asking the judge for a clear order: stop the illegal flow now and keep it stopped. We're not trying to undo past elections. We're just trying to protect future ones. Nebraska belongs to Nebraskans. We will not sit quietly while someone tries to buy our ballot box. With your support, we will keep fighting until the law is respected and our voice is the only one that decides our future. Mike Hilgers

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair Fellow Republicans, I've had a very difficult time focusing on politics this week. With record-breaking wildfires in Central and Western Nebraska, my mind constantly goes to those who are suffering the loss of home, livestock, feed, and grassland. My mind also goes to the first responders - our law enforcement, firefighters, and medical personnel - who show up to work when needed despite their own personal obligations and risks to their property. Many of us who live in rural areas rely on volunteer firefighters. The volunteer fire departments struggle for funding for equipment, maintenance, and training. Let's take some time in the upcoming weeks to show some appreciation to our volunteers by donating to them with a note of thanks. Tragically one person has lost her life to the wildfires so far, but thanks be to God that there wasn't more loss of human life. As becoming Nebraskans, many fire departments and volunteers have shown up to fight the fires and serve the communities. As I write this, the fires are becoming more contained as time passes and winds subside. Let's continue to pray that we stay on this trajectory. Ironically while the wildfires were building, eastern parts of the state suffered high winds and blizzard conditions last weekend that resulted in two deaths and we keep their families in prayer. None of us knows what the day will bring. As a result of dangerous roads and low visibility, Wayne County Republicans had to reschedule their county convention from last Sunday to Friday April 10th. The NEGOP will keep an eye on other county conventions if they must be rescheduled. Praying that the coming days bring us better tidings and that our western brothers and sisters can soon begin the long journey towards healing. May God show mercy on us all. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Peter, For the first time in a generation, we have the chance to change Georgia — **together.** Democrats are running in 204 state legislative races this year. That's 88% of the State House and 82% of the Senate. It’s a level of strength we haven’t seen since last century. That means in communities across the state — including places long overlooked — everyday people are stepping up. They’re running because they believe in a better future for Georgia – and for the country. The truth is, Georgia will decide the future of the Democratic party. If we don’t expand our strength and elect Democrats up and down the ballot here, defeating the GOP nationally will become nearly impossible. The Democrats running in state legislative races this year are ready to fight for all of us. Now, let's stand with them. Peter, Happy Renewable Energy Day! Today takes me back to where my journey began, long before I became a lawyer or a professor.

I earned my bachelor’s degree in environmental engineering, and during that time, I spent years studying how pollutants spread, how fossil fuels impact us, and what it actually takes to push back against that damage. What stuck with me most wasn’t just the problems we face, but the possibility of solutions.

**And what a triumph of environmental engineering renewable energy is!**

For generations, fossil fuels have powered our economy, but they also left behind devastating consequences, ones we’re still living with today. From climate change driven by greenhouse gas emissions, to polluted air contributing to respiratory illness, to the environmental damage caused by extraction, the costs have been disproportionately borne by working families and disadvantaged communities.

**What excites me about renewable energy is that it offers us a different path. By harnessing energy from the sun, wind, and water, we have the opportunity to protect our environment while building healthier communities.** And right now, Iowa is the second largest producer of wind energy in the nation – that's incredible!

That’s also why smart policy matters. When government works the way it should, it can help make these choices more accessible through tools like tax credits that lower costs for families and businesses investing in clean energy.

Unfortunately, that’s not the direction we’re seeing from everyone in Washington. Even though our state is already making strides in renewable energy, Mariannette Miller-Meeks voted to roll back key clean energy tax credits for wind, solar, and battery storage. She is making our electricity bills more expensive every day.

**[I’ll work to protect our environment and be a strong partner in helping Iowans make the transition to cleaner energy in ways that work for their lives and their budgets. If you believe in that vision too, will you chip in to support my campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127784932/609198175/-2011951990?refcode=em26_260321_climat_fndd_gq_act___cb_ettx&&&&utm_campaign=em26_260321_climat_fndd_gq_act___cb_ettx&&&&utm_medium=email&&&&refcode2=ca15ee79-3825-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjYTE1ZWU3OS0zODI1LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sqftaWTkz_JgCGUnnE7z9vFPBqcSCVo1EwnXmMELOKg=)**

Thank you,

Christina

| Peter,
The effort to redistrict Colorado is now officially underway but with that we have some good news and some bad news.
The good news: Yesterday, Colorado's Title Board approved (though we may still face legal changes) an initial measure to allow voters to decide on new congressional maps to fight back against Trump's fascist power grab by erasing 3 MAGA seats.
The bad news: unsurprisingly, a MAGA-backed, dark-money-funded group--Advance Colorado, with deep ties to extremists and even Russian oligarchs-- stepped in at the 11th hour with their own ballot initiative aimed at undercutting our efforts.
---
| [](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018nkcs_GkIKPPhDgWiDFfG_WBh_bpaJ7drnPD5WVU36_ghwYAoRlNS2FY67sPhAS2ZGwLnZyDmVgpP0H491Anb6NGNhqQL7KOgRwy_ZfD1YhzpnFNBfw9TausYQM-Re3z3ESI_LIK50mmi9RWKft4Oejz2dSUAxCmFBaxlw8RVI0hLAPuuIkek6-k5ZDOEnf7B4FyGsc_VLkQoAdv8xNRFgvLeRVO1Kxv&c=LPHmT0F_MkpdyWW97QmN7l8d04KwqFhQbVYHMU1RDD3BUiQ2djvMxQ==&ch=AuoWPDyWCWJxnsYIbWR58B1PgVTZ1wgbTGoobQ0RbJRAcUrgTIqSdg==)
---

Their proposal calls for an alternative redistricting process couched in "fairness" which Democrats would not be in control of and would ensure that Colorado does not fight back against MAGA redistricting.
This drastically complicates what was initially a clearcut pathway to passing this redistrict.
Now not only do we need to collect the 200,000 signatures needed to get our initiative on the ballot but we now must mount a legal offensive to ensure that their counter-proposal does not reach the ballot where it could compete against ours and confuse voters.
If we can't nip their effort in the bud, and trust us our lawyers are doing their damndest to stop it - yesterday they fought tooth and nail at Title Board to oppose it, we will have to challenge every one of their 200k signatures, a painstaking process that will cost us millions.
And if that doesn't stop it we will ultimately have to prepare to campaign for voters to pass our redistricting and vote against theirs. A worst case scenario though by no means insurmountable.
We are prepared to aggressively tackle each of the above outcomes but suffice to say this endeavor just became astronomically more expensive. [Please, rush a donation of what you can to help ensure we can surmount MAGA's attempt at stopping our effort. Our average donation is $30, many give more, some give less, the amount doesn't matter because they will add up.](https://eub669hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0018nkcs_GkIKPPhDgWiDFfG_WBh_bpaJ7drnPD5WVU36_ghwYAoRlNS2FY67sPhAS2Jh_ZVTXYnq1lZsBp7nrOwl-4B3FS_PZx94uGJpdWIZi2ucr_MHzaxVDpeshSx_84AWR5rw9Wt5ALuc785vWRvGrLOgb0zXdjaA6ZqfRlyGnWM8h2N3UVT7bGRMY1MT7YKGZFxLetxsYj5rYj83ejZMF5PRCM-MmOn7rShXpW674=&c=LPHmT0F_MkpdyWW97QmN7l8d04KwqFhQbVYHMU1RDD3BUiQ2djvMxQ==&ch=AuoWPDyWCWJxnsYIbWR58B1PgVTZ1wgbTGoobQ0RbJRAcUrgTIqSdg==)

Peter, I just finished my morning run — five miles before the sun came up. With spring around the corner in Tennessee, it’s one of my favorite times of year to get outside. When I’m not on the campaign trail, I’m usually outside running, biking with my kids, or playing pickleball with friends around Columbia. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/97X5MIek_Z9l6rjg2-2Oig~~/AAUS1hA~/mI3zBjwbmigplgl-PUFY51BbW2qh6VLCtOLMU8bkZzBazHHuM93Z4x1RpKhFDNsaic7jK0Nb3HWd1Jei-Kn1h-1dRzGzB1l66ruuTRNJ26wkDn8zFehj1GQ4dp1D6qZ9gLMPT0k9jbOn747qvbwUi-9JlkLUD3e4RIu4MV53zng2M3WgI6oy703bDFDNTJLz3q9hjYD8vr-Jusv5AYub2QTNscL9VQzKKmRNc54bQQ6D9VhwMkxISwGKCyOJ-wbmpI3N6XOdd5ehQ2xRdHvt4A~~) Something about spring in Tennessee makes it a little easier to get out the door before sunrise. That’s the same mindset I’ve tried to bring to serving as mayor — listening to people, working across differences, and focusing on solving problems for the community we call home. It’s also the approach I want to bring to Congress. We’re building a grassroots campaign across TN-5, and support from people like you is what keeps it moving forward. Friends, Because of your support, **Dax Alexander is in the Primary Runoff!** We’ve come a long way, but the work isn’t over. In a runoff, every single vote is magnified. This is our chance to decide what the future of Texas’ 1st Congressional District looks like. Do we want more of the same, or are we ready for a representative who fights for the working families of East Texas?
### **Here's Why This Matters**
Dax is running because he believes that healthcare is a human right, not a luxury. He’s running to stop the siphoning of public dollars away from our rural schools and to solve the "brain drain" that takes our best and brightest away from East Texas. **Our Priorities for the Runoff:**
* **Healthcare:** Expanding Medicaid and capping prescription drug prices so no East Texan has to choose between medicine and groceries.
* **Education:** Securing funding for our education and rural districts.
* ******Opportunity:** Bringing high-paying jobs to East Texas by expanding high-speed broadband and supporting local small businesses and trade schools.

### **Here's How We Win**
Runoffs are won by the campaign that shows up. We need you to help us maintain this momentum through May. **1\. Mark Your Calendar:**
* **Early Voting:** May 18 – May 22
* **Election Day:** Tuesday, May 26

**2\. Join the Ground Team:** We are knocking on doors and making calls every day until the polls close. [Sign Up Now](https://gxwexbq.clicks.mlsend.com/tf/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjE2NjExMzIsXCJsXCI6MTgyNTY0MDQ4NzkxOTMwNTY3LFwiclwiOjE4MjU2NDA2MTExMTY0OTk0Mn0iLCJzIjoiY2Q5NTgxZGM3ODkzOTIxOSJ9) **3\. Let’s finish what we started.
With gratitude and hope, Dax Alexander Candidate for U.S. Congress, TX-01

Peter, I’m
going to level with you. This is another fundraising email.

I know, I know... You probably didn’t wake up today thinking, “I can’t wait
for Abdul to send me an email!” but I’m hoping you’ll give me a chance to
explain why these emails are so important for our campaign.

I'm the only candidate in this race who has never taken a dime from AIPAC
or corporate PACs, and never will.

That decision has its pros and cons.

The biggest pro is that I get to act independently and center this
campaign around policies that working people actually want: Medicare for
All, abolishing ICE, using our taxpayer dollars to improve life here
rather than fund endless war overseas.

The biggest con is that I have to be constantly fundraising, including in
emails like this. Trust me, I don’t like having to repeatedly ask for
money, but it’s the only way a campaign like ours can compete.

Here’s why I’m reaching out today specifically:

March 31 marks another quarterly FEC fundraising deadline.

When it passes, our fundraising numbers will become public, and everyone,
including our opponents, will be looking at them.

If we show up strong, we’ll have the resources to keep growing this
movement and reach more voters across Michigan.

If we fall short, it gives corporate-backed candidates and their
billionaire donors an opening to flood this race with money and try to
shut us down.

Hi – my name is Nancy Lacore, and I’m running for Congress in SC-01.

South Carolinians are facing that same reality under Nancy Mace. I’m running for Congress because I refuse to accept that this is just “how things work now.”
I’m running because integrity matters.

| Dear Patriot,
[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D) Your critical gift of **[**$25, $50, $100 or more**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)** will help NCLU expose a corrupt government — and fight for veterans who've been left with nothing. Let me tell you about Travis. He was a decorated U.S. Army veteran with 14 years of service. Six years from retirement. A man who had given everything to his country. **Then corrupt officials in West Virginia decided to destroy him.** Why? Because Travis's ex-wife didn't want to share custody of their daughter. And she just happened to be the stepdaughter of a local judge... and the mistress of a high-ranking county law enforcement officer. They coerced a false statement. They manufactured a conviction. They had Travis thrown out of the military and stripped of his security clearance. His career — gone. His retirement — gone. His ability to fight for his daughter — gone. **They thought they'd buried him.** ******[Donate Now ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)** But they didn't count on the National Constitutional Law Union. I'm John Pierce — Harvard Law graduate, former editor of the Harvard Law Review, and Army veteran. I was a partner at Quinn Emanuel, the #1 business litigation firm in America. I built a law firm with a $700 million litigation portfolio. **I walked away from all of it to fight for Americans like Travis.** On Halloween 2025, NCLU filed a Writ of Coram Nobis on Travis's behalf — one of the rarest legal tools in existence, used only three times in West Virginia history. What happened next shocked everyone. EVERY judge in that circuit court recused themselves. **Every. Single. One.** A fair, outside judge was brought in to handle the case. Then came the bombshell... **A special prosecutor has been assigned** — working with a West Virginia State Police investigator into the crimes alleged in our filing. **Two circuit court judges are now under criminal investigation.** Along with several others. And the probe is growing by the day. The Governor of West Virginia is watching this case. **Courts across the nation are watching this case.** **[****](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)******[ Donate Now](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)**** The final evidentiary hearing is scheduled **for April 2**. I'm going in personally — _pro hac vice_ — to stand beside Travis in that courtroom. [**But I need your help to get there**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D). Travel. Hotel. A local attorney to formally admit me to argue the case. These are real costs with a real deadline. **Patriot** , NCLU has no billionaire donors. No war chest. We have patriots like you — Americans who believe no corrupt official should be above the law. Please **[**donate $25, $50, $100 or more**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)** right now to help NCLU finish what we started. Justice is within reach. Don't let it slip away. For Justice,
John M. Pierce
Harvard Law '00, NCLU Founder
**P.S.** Patriot, two circuit court judges are under criminal investigation because NCLU refused to abandon a veteran who had nothing left. The April 2 hearing could change everything — not just for Travis, but for every American facing corrupt local government. Peter,

We have FOUR seats to defend, FOUR champions to protect, and FOUR
districts that we cannot let fall into the hands of opponents.

Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan, and Rashida are fighting for bold progressive

voices.

communities, and a quieter movement at the exact moment it needs to be
loud.

Derek,

If you spend any time on social media or watching cable news, you’d think we’re all fighting with each other. For the sake of my own sanity, I spend as little time on Twitter/X as I can. But I am a reader (I read A LOT) and I just read a new report that’s both interesting and hopeful. I wanted to share it with you.
Third Way and Global Strategy Group just published **[The Truth About Democratic Primary Voters](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127789714/609210826/1009139470?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1240-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOTNjNTUwYy0zZjI1LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eZab1oqRfxHZRebN4g1nk1ZUcBujAVp0T60oCfek8lU=&emci=b9844ab1-7d24-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=a93c550c-3f25-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=21278485)** , which finds that the "typical" Democratic primary voter isn't an online activist or a political operative.
* The typical Democratic primary voter didn’t graduate from college (60%), watches the NFL regularly (56%), is Christian (58%), is female (61%), and white (65%).
* The typical Democratic primary voter has not attended a protest in the last year (only 16% have), does not take public transit (only 24%), is not in a book club (only 7%; this one hurts), and does not post about politics online (only 13%; this one makes me happy).

The research also shows that our party is unified by a powerful, pragmatic vision for the future. I love that. Here is what the data actually says about what Democratic primary voters are looking for in a leader:
* Results Over Rhetoric: 75% of primary voters prefer a candidate who is willing to work across the aisle to get things done, rather than someone who sticks to a script but achieves nothing.
* A "Big Tent" Consensus: There is near-unanimous support (93% to 96%) for protecting the Affordable Care Act and investing in vocational training and apprenticeships.
* The "Authenticity" Factor: 72% would rather vote for someone we don’t agree with on every single issue, as long as they are authentic and true to what they believe.

The "online" world might want us to be divided, but this report proves that the vast majority of Democrats—liberals and moderates alike—are standing together. We want a fighter for the working class who knows how to deliver. That sounds like someone we know. 🙂
**[**_Will you chip in $5, $10, or even $100 today to help Chrissy bring this results-driven vision to every corner of the 6th District?_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127789718/609210829/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1240-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhOTNjNTUwYy0zZjI1LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eZab1oqRfxHZRebN4g1nk1ZUcBujAVp0T60oCfek8lU=) **She’s not interested in winning a Twitter war. She’s interested in winning for you. Let’s keep moving forward, together.****
With gratitude and hope,

Michelle

| This is bigger than politics.

It’s about what kind of country we’re going to be.

Do we remain a nation where people can serve without fear of political retribution? Or do we go down a path where power is used to settle scores?

That’s not the America Kansans believe in.

**We believe in freedom, fairness, and a future where the next generation inherits a stronger, more stable country.**

But that future is not guaranteed. It depends on whether we have the resources to stand up, speak out, and fight back.

If you’re able, will you [chip in $25, $50, or even $100 today ](https://traceymann.us4.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60a16ea89a176679a5f31366c&id=4f96e23f1e&e=a9d1410029)to help me continue this fight?

Every dollar helps us push back, hold the line, and defend the principles that make this country worth fighting for.

And if you can, I’m asking you to step up again before the next major deadline. Even a small, additional contribution makes a real difference in ensuring we have the strength to keep going.

Tracey Mann

subject: Members of Congress take up our call
body:
We’re living through the most dangerous moment in DACA’s 14-year history. | | | Peter, **** Last year, because we heard directly from our communities about the detentions and deportations of DACA recipients and immigrant youth, we launched the Immigrant Youth Disappearance Tracker to collect evidence. We worked with Senators Dick Durbin, Alex Padilla, and Mark Kelly as well as Representatives Sylvia Garcia and Delia Ramirez to demand answers from DHS, which confirmed that more than 260 DACA recipients have been detained and more than 86 have been deported, along with 174 DACA applicants. **This week, a group of lawmakers held a press conference challenging DHS over these illegal detentions and deportations, demanding****an immediate end to these family separations and pushing for a legislative solution that provides permanent protections****.** Members of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, Congressional Black Caucus, Congressional Asian Pacific American Caucus, Democratic Women’s Caucus, New Democrat Coalition, and the Congressional Progressive Caucus participated along with national immigrant rights advocates. A UWD spokesperson called for Congress to demand answers as to why DHS continues to unlawfully detain and deport DACA recipients, and demand that DHS stop this practice and resume honoring the promises made not only to DACA recipients, but to TPS holders, asylum seekers, and refugees. There is no overstating that we are living through the most dangerous moment in DACA’s 14-year history, a moment that demands decisive congressional action to protect our communities and ensure stability and safety for our country. **Thanks to your support, we were able to launch the Home is Here tracker and document these abuses. We will not stop pressuring lawmakers to deliver permanent protections to the hundreds of thousands of DACA recipients who power our economy and country.** **** [**We need your help fueling our advocacy efforts. Can you make a donation to United We Dream today? subject: Friend, what If It Were Your Child?
body:
This Lent, your faith can help protect the innocent.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e8027256/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvVW5LR3IzVzZTcA/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjAzMjE/LbmNsV0dLQ29qOA/qP2hpZHM9bmM3eVpTNm1aSWdaMzVscw/gab7GXA/s4g2cf6e369)
| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| |
---
| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend,
---
Lent is not just a season. It is a pilgrimage. A journey led by the Holy Spirit... into the desert. **And the desert is not empty.**
**It is sacred.**
**It is where God reminds us who we are.** When Jesus entered the desert, He was tempted. He was tested.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
But even then, one holy declaration still echoed from Heaven and did not change: **_“You are my beloved Son.”_** That same Father speaks over you. **You are His beloved son.**
**His beloved daughter.** Before any label.
Before any denomination. And so is every child. Even the child who has been lured... kidnapped... sold.
---
You may not know me yet. My name is Eduardo Verástegui. I produced the film _Sound of Freedom_ after meeting real-life rescuers who risk everything to save children from trafficking. **What I heard broke my heart.** Children treated like products.
Like profit.
Like they do not matter. I asked myself, _“What if it were my child?”_ That question changed my life. The film became a movement.
And the **Sound of Freedom Foundation was born.** But the story did not end when the credits rolled. Today, our foundation works to prevent trafficking before it begins. We **equip** trusted partners who rescue children.
We **educate** families so they can protect their sons and daughters.
We **advocate** for laws that defend the innocent. This is not politics.
It is protection.
**It is faith in action.**
---
[ Protect God’s Children Now ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
But if we are honest... Our hearts can grow numb and we get distracted. We get comfortable. **Lent is a wake-up call.** A time for metanoia.
A turning back to God. This Lenten season, pause and ask the Holy Spirit: “What do **You** want to restore in me?” Your prayer life?
Your courage?
Your tenderness toward the vulnerable? Because when hearts grow cold...children suffer. And today, many of God’s children are enslaved. **They are created in His image.**
**They belong to Him.**
**Their dignity is sacred.** When we forget that... the innocent pay the price.
---
[ Protect God’s Children Now ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
During Lent, I pray more intentionally. **I ask the Holy Spirit to strengthen us for this battle.** As a Catholic, I also ask for the prayers of the faithful who have gone before us. I ask **Our Lady of Guadalupe** to intercede for these little ones.
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
I ask **Saint Joseph** to guard them.
I ask **Saint Michael** to defend them. Not instead of God. But asking them to pray with us... **as one family in Christ.**
Because this is spiritual warfare. **Light against darkness.** And Jesus was clear: _“Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.”_ (Matthew 25:40) When we protect a child, **we serve Christ.**
When we rescue the vulnerable, **we love Christ.** Friend, you may be hearing about this mission for the first time. But maybe this is not an accident. **Maybe the Holy Spirit is inviting you into something deeper this Lent.**
---
[ Protect God’s Children Now ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
**Let Him restore your heart.** And together, let us restore freedom to enslaved children of God. This is not about one church.
**It is about the Gospel.** **It is about the truth that every human life has dignity because it comes from God.** So we say it boldly: **God’s children are not for sale.** Not in our nation. Not in our world.
Not ever. Will you stand with us?
---
With gratitude and prayer,
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation
---
[ Support the Sound of Freedom Foundation ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074
---

This email was sent to **[dpwillis67@gmail.com](mailto:dpwillis67@gmail.com)** as part of your subscription to **America First War Room**

108 S Washington St. Suite 200
Alexandria, VA 22314

[Unsubscribe](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e8027256/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3N1YnNjcmlwdGlvbnMvdW5zdWJzY3JpYmU/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjAzMjE/LbmNsV0dLQ29qOA/qP2hpZHM9bmM3eVpTNm1aSWdaMzVscw/gab7GXA/sejb5cb5d2f)

body:
My new legislation protects whistleblowers and our First Amendment rights. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOZKmTtnV3k2h4V2x_O3H7rdW2az5rgktBwzxQ8Ml9Wgkmv85qW-UsBonL4KRa0bcNqdICU6T3NBDdNIZG7w7wEWRR-3RrjDM7P1mEbF-PcSoHP5PzELdhluAVI1hCm5KSWzYQkLKg9YC79xHEpPOyZTgBAaGWD7Z4tPVtume_89S-DQgTDDfMKm5-_DWn5JE_DkMAXfNar55DTikDtOskui-JhiSz6w0asKqL-2vFjWa60AHu1q0kmTJBGpIpmm06HZnMhi_2MhaX4Fq-uLfH-QyK5WDwjsAO8EwmrQCMxPUt8gpv-KiqrnP9FG2vDrGsumvifPeqkqyxpx3jk8zsvE/4p4/VkrFyFuHRae0IjybWwnZrQ/h0/h001.pVHNaRU4ILGwsJPfE9bWl0eQMp7DF1xBi4JKxGxhgSE)
---
Friend, We can’t stay silent as Trump attacks our First Amendment rights and our fundamental right to due process. Trump has sued news outlets that criticize him and tried to dismantle broadcasters such as Voice of America. **Now, his FCC chair is threatening to take away the licenses of news outlets whose coverage of the illegal war on Iran isn’t to Trump’s liking.** Trump has fired whistleblowers from federal agencies, and his Justice Department has also weaponized the _Espionage Act_ to prosecute whistleblowers. His Attorney General has even taken steps to make it easier to target journalists who publish classified information. **To defend our civil liberties and stop these attempts to silence dissent, I just introduced legislation to reform the**** _Espionage Act_****, which would prevent its abuse against whistleblowers, journalists, and the American public for exposing government corruption and wrongdoing.** [**Will you sign on today to support the**** _Daniel Ellsberg Press Freedom and Whistleblower Protection Act_****and demand protections for whistleblowers?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9Fmwy405z692crFv5rOTSCsTaPcsjuw0Tkj-qm2Qt2F3AktBOovhN0bBKotizbCHwU0qIpYhbDhWc-LXfDa3MXZ3IuFKYBjYfTP18q9iHlS4zMSJYvShp8RceCGxKEbAroWrI29dDvyftwVvgky16JRAX-QAmbKnq8ksAMQsy8ual-NDb0nVAc1Q-VVDEiP21sQI39DdZ0ClY0OTPtlOj0P_r3M3ROxJt5e7mdDGoaLKFhelIPacyhripA3EYWU-p0ohfihjVy2yremzjEbqvIVT-gDozji71rbVZcJoSA_GlEl2J75tt3vB7WytLMK_TOvrYXISologqU0djxT7tFUvynh8Mlhhn9zOeMsFBq3LnK7HK4f3L1DzGF-CmvkceiyXC5x0LcpRnPXVlOQlm_wVw/4p4/VkrFyFuHRae0IjybWwnZrQ/h1/h001.O7Sjg4As6flXyWveQnMKkCDeI1txGRbpsakYI72P4UQ) | [SIGN ON](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9Fmwy405z692crFv5rOTSCsTaPcsjuw0Tkj-qm2Qt2F3AktBOovhN0bBKotizbCHwU0cobzgrOqPFM1znCAg9SsZjCnu_gWX9ET4s4A5DzqX0IOeScygebbjIMaWdxEkFsMnAb4nOKNEZfVclLrqk-OTDlTZS5hXNyX3gtyEYJmzeOeCqTBWBDQc0QcbmPlooppN13GKCBxxZWAlZ2UrUWMNBEgGHOarOwrANJjwAriBhvTpZgOQjVLanWTKSeHBBiRMcyWFCoo8BpoIoG9SYGppcNyZ2fnbs_Ca432zyNF2gNGgqKqgWHCRONSQlOtSKZK35tnsmqUlKNTlre4CrRuAEEZynzFc9P10rfmSApD4TSCCJkTvo8onSRmiliAhisPzQYI7hxJaNu2tpDUeMvDnw/4p4/VkrFyFuHRae0IjybWwnZrQ/h2/h001.oqDj50IXD5zFJUR5YLenN6q8ni5CWaM2QaNGTRXv4QE)
---
The **_Daniel Ellsberg Press Freedom and Whistleblower Protection Act_** is named in honor of the late Daniel Ellsberg, the celebrated Detroiter and whistleblower who bravely exposed government lies about the Vietnam War with the Pentagon Papers and faced charges under the _Espionage Act_.
Before he passed in 2023, Daniel expressed public support for these reforms when I introduced them as an amendment to the _National Defense Authorization Act_.
Previous Democratic and Republican presidential administrations have abused the _Espionage Act_ to undermine government transparency and target people who share critically important information with the public.
**With increasing attacks on whistleblowers, journalists, activists, and our civil liberties, we must urgently rein in the abuses of the**** _Espionage Act_****.**
If passed,**my new bill would limit the scope of the**** _Espionage Act_****** to government employees with a legal duty to protect classified information and foreign agents.**** This would prevent the use of the law against publishers, journalists, or members of the general public.
The _Daniel Ellsberg Press Freedom and Whistleblower Protection Act_ would also **increase due process standards and safeguards for whistleblowers who alert the public to wrongdoing, war crimes, and other abuses of power**.
This legislation has been endorsed by a variety of groups that advocate for our human and constitutional rights, including the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU), Amnesty International USA, and the Committee to Protect Journalists.
[**Will you add your name today to support my urgently-needed legislation to protect whistleblowers and our First Amendment rights?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9Fmwy405z692crFv5rOTSCsTaPcsjuw0Tkj-qm2Qt2F3AktBOovhN0bBKotizbCHwU0GR9OJE7J64nDSl1et-o_Lx_3hbcptfbXcu3IsH1r9RIbQXBMs34FEPjAXQK964U9YoLb_VgPh5x-iANcfYjVjwo3MnHnD73zVzy9atO8Bx2X8RST40Gs9iSBMJmBijdmJCecXsWQmwj-XLNRBBWDQoZ12ZAbPoZnYl0_UwnzNOac4IdlcrsF3XILXyvgwhE2ire8lyx1WOH-0a0P2jlHJrV5K5SAGIB7kM8f9cljk1iJSFO6rRQ4WA4WdrigY5zrhouowtmJgUR5XcV68SGYAh7qAqWAa9kNNfvkIwojgvhc0dTnhFqBxzsgvCa9AzqKJLKkjFTICeeZSja2Rb5Z8w/4p4/VkrFyFuHRae0IjybWwnZrQ/h3/h001.JwQ8IkKWznClzjo16KYg09UR__6TY9yhF3FKmKGsri0)
Thank you for being by my side in the fight for our rights.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
