| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

subject: Trump just rolled back one of the most important climate protections we have
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
In Delaware, we’re already living with the consequences of climate change every single day.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=2986%2E21716%2Erp4aOx)
I wanted to make sure you saw this:
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-20260321-epa/?source=em20260321-2986&t=2&akid=2986%2E21716%2Erp4aOx)
The Trump administration just moved to roll back one of the most important climate protections we have: an EPA ruling that greenhouse gases endanger public health.
That finding has been the foundation for limits on pollution that keep our air cleaner and our families safer _since 2009_ , and now they’re trying to erase it — all because they want to make it easier for fossil fuel companies to pollute, with fewer consequences and more profit.
In Delaware, we’re already living with the consequences of climate change every single day. As the lowest-lying state in the country, rising sea levels threaten our communities and our economy. And with summers getting longer and hotter, kids and seniors are at risk, and our energy grid is under strain.
**We don’t have the luxury of ignoring the science and pretending this isn’t real.** And we certainly can’t afford leaders who put corporate profits ahead of people’s health.
[**That’s why I’m asking you to sign my petition demanding the EPA reverse this dangerous decision and restore these critical protections for our environment.**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-20260321-epa/?source=em20260321-2986&t=3&akid=2986%2E21716%2Erp4aOx)
**[Sign the Petition »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/signup/em-20260321-epa/?source=em20260321-2986&t=4&akid=2986%2E21716%2Erp4aOx)**
If enough of us raise our voices together, we can push back and hold this administration accountable.
So thank you for joining me in speaking out.
— Sarah McBride

| | A whistleblower just revealed that a former Trump-appointed contractor may have taken highly sensitive Social Security data onto a personal device — including names, Social Security numbers, and birthdates. **That’s millions of Americans’ private records potentially exposed.** **[If you agree that voters’ data must be protected, please add your name to my petition today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127803049/609251789/234684744?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDk1NmMzMS02YjI1LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q_LGqtNHG1kGfWw-7LHoDCJJYCQTMXltUlNU-PtGnUQ=&emci=54877274-6225-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=ed956c31-6b25-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=30662126)**

And it gets worse. The contractor reportedly had “God-level” access to these systems. That kind of access should never fall into the wrong hands. * Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

After a 13-hour surgery and ICU stay, I defied doctors with 10 post-op pushups. The cancer is gone, and I’m still here. It was at this moment I knew God had given me more time for a reason. So I joined the Air Force, and was deployed to Qatar in 2024 for Central Command – earning a Meritorious Service Medal and more. | That’s when my life completely changed. In 2018, President Trump appointed me as White House Fellow. I advised his administration on tackling opioids, rescuing prisoners of war, and leading counterterrorism efforts. When I went back home to Georgia, I served as District Attorney – delivering life sentences to murderers, rapists, gang members, and fentanyl drug traffickers. But that’s not the end of my mission. I still have a lot more fight left in me. | Today, I’m running for Congress to lock down Marjorie Taylor Greene’s vacant seat for the America First movement. With faith in God, support from my family, and the backing of conservatives like YOU, I will secure our borders, bring jobs back to America, and fight like hell for President Trump’s agenda. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. # **Project Veritas founder James O 'Keefe violently attacked on LA's Skid Row while investigating alleged voter fraud**
Project Veritas founder James O'Keefe and his team **[were violently attacked on Skid Row](https://substack.com/redirect/5ea692dc-0024-4093-b4d3-352359d58cae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while confronting men accused of voter fraud, with his cameraman allegedly punched in the face and neck and others hit with pepper spray, forcing the group to flee. O'Keefe wrote on social media "we were in the heart of Skid Row confronting the petitioners who my team caught on tape illegally offering drugs for ballot signatures," adding some team members "had to run 10 blocks to get out."

* **Why it matters:** O'Keefe released undercover footage earlier this week showing himself posing as a homeless person on Skid Row, watching people sign an election-related petition and receive cash--illegal in California--with petitioners suggesting at least one homeless person fake their address and sign it as "Pinocchio Lane." The footage captured individuals talking about being paid per signature, suggesting people use inaccurate addresses, and offering cigarettes, cash, or drugs in exchange for signatures.
* **What 's next:** Officials acknowledged the video, with a federal prosecutor signaling potential election law violations would be taken seriously, though no specific investigation has been confirmed. Project Veritas, known for undercover sting videos exposing alleged misconduct, has released footage claiming election-related fraud, though officials say no widespread illegal activity has been found.

# **Elon Musk offers to pay TSA salaries as DHS shutdown enters second month, leaving 50,000 workers without pay**
Elon Musk**[offered Saturday to personally cover TSA agent salaries](https://substack.com/redirect/332eb8be-bc30-4384-8dc7-77f9dd3d01ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as a partial Department of Homeland Security shutdown stretches into its second month, writing on X "I would like to offer to pay the salaries of TSA personnel during this funding impasse that is negatively affecting the lives of so many Americans at airports."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/332eb8be-bc30-4384-8dc7-77f9dd3d01ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **The situation:** Roughly 50,000 TSA workers classified as essential employees are working without pay and approaching a second missed paycheck, with security wait times stretching beyond three hours at major hubs--120 minutes in Houston, 70 minutes in Atlanta, and 46 minutes at LaGuardia.

* **Why it matters:** Union officials say officers are sleeping in cars, facing eviction, selling plasma, or taking gig jobs delivering packages while airports respond with emergency food drives, meal vouchers, gas cards, and on-site pantries. Hundreds have already quit, raising concerns staffing shortages could persist even after funding is restored. Republicans push for funding individual DHS branches while Democrats refuse until immigration reform is promised, leaving the agency in limbo despite ICE and CBP continuing operations funded by the "One Big Beautiful Bill."
* **The complications:** Musk's offer raises legal and logistical questions about whether a private individual could directly pay federal employees within labor and appropriations laws, as federal pay is tightly controlled by Congress and outside compensation could conflict with ethics rules.

# **NYC Mayor Mamdani breaks Ramadan fast at Rikers Island with Muslim inmates, calls it "one of most meaningful evenings"**
NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani broke his Ramadan fast with Muslim inmates at Rikers Island, calling it "one of the most meaningful evenings" he's had as mayor and saying **["this is me just being a Muslim New Yorker.](https://substack.com/redirect/e8d8ba57-e9d9-4545-9343-761fc6f9ee26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** There are some for whom that is a political act." Before arriving, he reiterated his pledge to shut down the jail and absorb the population into borough-based jails, hinting at plans to hire a facilitator to expedite closure.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e8d8ba57-e9d9-4545-9343-761fc6f9ee26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** Social media erupted after Mamdani's post, with critics questioning his decision to visit Rikers' violent criminals. Mystery novelist Daniel Friedman said "you have to be an absolute monster to be sent to Rikers Island these days" with "long histories of doing things so horrible that even the woke, pro-crime judges and prosecutors in NYC don't want to be responsible." Emmy-winning producer Daniella Greenbaum Davis asked if Mamdani had "also visited their victims / the families of their victims," noting "a bizarre progressive determination to invert victimization."
* **The backlash:** Sen. Tommy Tuberville shared a photo of Mamdani at a Museum of the City of New York iftar alongside a photo of the burning Twin Towers on 9/11, captioning it "the enemy is inside the gates." Tuberville defended the post, saying "I just go by his rhetoric. He's made a lot of statements about his stance with Islam and radical Islam" and "we need to make the country better; we don't need to divide it. That's what he's doing in New York."

Wednesday, Blue Amp Media did something we've only done once before.
We went live on Substack for 12 straight hours -- the BAM Substackapalooza -- with 20+ guests, a production team running on adrenaline and caffeine, and an audience that showed up and stayed with us all day long. We are still processing how incredible it was.
We're publishing the full show in four parts. This post contains **the first six hours** -- 11 AM through the afternoon -- and it is, frankly, a lot.
**🎬 Watch the six-hour video above.**
Here's who joined us in this block:
**Steve Schmidt** opened the show at 11 AM and did not hold back. **Malcolm Nance** followed at 11:30 with the kind of intelligence-community perspective you're not getting anywhere else. **Chris Matthews** joined at noon. **Jon Tester and Maritsa Georgiou** were with us at 12:30 PM -- a conversation that covered everything from the state of the Democratic Party to what's actually happening on the ground. **Julie Roginsky** brought her trademark sharp analysis at 1:00 PM, and **Wajahat Ali** -- one of the most vital voices in progressive media -- was with us at 1:30 PM. **Miles Taylor and Xander Schultz** of Defiance.org joined at 2:00 PM for a conversation about what real resistance looks like in 2025 and beyond. **Glenn Kirschner** brought the prosecutorial heat at 2:30 PM. **Lev Parnas** joined us at 3:00 PM with the kind of candor that only someone who's been through what he's been through can bring. **Qasim Rashid** was with us at 3:30 PM, and **Chris Kluwe** closed out the afternoon block at 4:00 PM.
That's eleven guests in six hours. And we were just getting started.
* * *
**🎬 The evening blocks are published separately -- watch them here:**
* **5 -7 PM** -- [Olga Lautman, Jonathan Larsen, Joe Walsh, Nina Burleigh](https://substack.com/redirect/a7adbba3-fe37-4566-b917-2ba89cb8767a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **7 -9 PM** -- [Brian Karem, Mike Madrid, Rachel Bitecofer, Joy Reid](https://substack.com/redirect/ef5667cd-b93a-477d-a07c-dcad2876f7bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **9 -11 PM** -- [Eric Lullove, Bill Corbett, Reed Galen, Matt Robison, and a special surprise final appearance by Hal Sparks](https://substack.com/redirect/9d6961a2-1620-4c42-a402-23cbe4114848?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
**🎁 The anniversary deal is still live -- but only through Sunday.**
We launched this marathon to celebrate one year of Blue Amp Media, and as a thank-you to the people who've been reading and watching us. That includes you.
Right now -- through **Sunday at 11:59 PM EDT** -- you can become a paid subscriber for **just $19.99 for the full year.** That's 75% off. Less than two dollars a month for independent, fearless progressive media that doesn't answer to advertisers, corporate owners, or anyone but you.

This price goes away Sunday night. We're not bringing it back.
* * *

For those in the Lower 48, mukluk telegraph is a saying we have in the Bush that basically amounts to gossip.

It’s passing along a message through our conversations with one another, _which is the only way information can really spread in some parts of the Last Frontier!_

In a state as vast and rural as ours, there really is no other way to reach every Alaskan. That’s why it’s so important for us to travel to their communities and have those person-to-person conversations.

Your critical gift of **[**$25, $50, $100 or more**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** will help NCLU expose a corrupt government — and fight for veterans who've been left with nothing. Let me tell you about Travis. He was a decorated U.S. Army veteran with 14 years of service. Six years from retirement. A man who had given everything to his country. **Then corrupt officials in West Virginia decided to destroy him.** Why? Because Travis's ex-wife didn't want to share custody of their daughter. And she just happened to be the stepdaughter of a local judge... and the mistress of a high-ranking county law enforcement officer. They coerced a false statement. They manufactured a conviction. They had Travis thrown out of the military and stripped of his security clearance. His career — gone. His retirement — gone. His ability to fight for his daughter — gone. **They thought they'd buried him.** ******[Donate Now](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.) ** But they didn't count on the National Constitutional Law Union. What happened next shocked everyone. EVERY judge in that circuit court recused themselves. **Every. Single. One.** A fair, outside judge was brought in to handle the case. Then came the bombshell... **A special prosecutor has been assigned** — working with a West Virginia State Police investigator into the crimes alleged in our filing. **Two circuit court judges are now under criminal investigation.** Along with several others. And the probe is growing by the day. The Governor of West Virginia is watching this case. **Courts across the nation are watching this case.** **[****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)******[Donate Now](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**** The final evidentiary hearing is scheduled **for April 2**. I'm going in personally — _pro hac vice_ — to stand beside Travis in that courtroom. [**But I need your help to get there**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.). Travel. Hotel. A local attorney to formally admit me to argue the case. These are real costs with a real deadline. **Patriot** , NCLU has no billionaire donors. No war chest. We have patriots like you — Americans who believe no corrupt official should be above the law. Please **[**donate $25, $50, $100 or more**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** right now to help NCLU finish what we started. Justice is within reach. Don't let it slip away. For Justice,
John M. Pierce
Harvard Law '00, NCLU Founder
**P.S.** Patriot, two circuit court judges are under criminal investigation because NCLU refused to abandon a veteran who had nothing left. The April 2 hearing could change everything — not just for Travis, but for every American facing corrupt local government. Friend —
For a good part of my professional life, I’ve been involved in creating and operating small businesses.
In business, you learn quickly that leadership isn’t about titles, it’s about rising to the challenge and solving problems head-on, supporting the people who depend on you, and making tough decisions that strengthen the people around you.
When a business succeeds in places like Grand Junction to Pueblo, it means jobs for local families, opportunities for the next generation, and stability for the community as a whole.
That experience shaped how I think about leadership — and ultimately why I decided to run for Congress.
I’m running because I believe public service should be grounded in the same principles that guide small businesses and strong communities: accountability, hard work, and a commitment to leaving things better than you found them.
We have a huge opportunity to restore commonsense leadership here in CO-03. Will you donate to help us keep growing this campaign across all 27 counties of CO-03? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2603-q1-ak]

NEW: I’m suing the Trump administration for their unlawful decision to roll back one of the most important climate protections in our country.
This marks my 63rd lawsuit against Donald Trump in less than 63 weeks — that’s how frequently this administration is breaking the law.
If that’s all you need to hear, click here to support our work holding Trump accountable before the end-of-quarter fundraising deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]
At the center of this case is something called the Endangerment Finding: the federal government’s official recognition that pollution from cars and trucks drives climate change and harms public health.
That finding is grounded in science, upheld by the courts, and relied on by Democratic and Republican administrations alike.
It’s also just common sense.
But now, Trump and his EPA are trying to erase it entirely.
They want to overrule science and eliminate the legal foundation for limiting pollution from vehicles — a sweeping move that would increase emissions, worsen air quality, and put millions of Americans at risk.
Their decision isn’t based on data, facts, or credible science. On the contrary, it ignores decades of research — and what we can plainly see with our own eyes: destructive wildfires, smoke-filled air, increasingly extreme storms, floods, and droughts.
If it’s allowed to stand, we’ll see more pollution, worse air quality, accelerated climate change, higher energy bills, higher insurance costs, even higher healthcare costs.
And the heaviest burden will fall on communities already facing the worst environmental harms.
Bottom line: Science is real. Climate change is real. And it’s harming our communities right now — whether or not that’s politically convenient for Donald Trump.
That’s why I’m taking action. The EPA is ignoring its legal obligation under the Clean Air Act, defying clear Supreme Court precedent, and attempting to overturn decades of settled science with discredited claims. That’s not how the law works — and it’s not how science works.
If you’re with me in this fight to defend science, protect our communities, and hold this lawless administration accountable, I’m asking you to join my re-election campaign before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26]

Donald Trump isn’t just running our country into the ground. He’s hand-picking the next generation of GOP candidates who will help him do it.
#
Peter,
Donald Trump isn't just running our country into the ground. He's hand-picking the next generation of GOP candidates who will help him do it.
Ahead of the 2026 midterms, Trump has issued endorsements in races across the country – and the people he's backing tell you everything you need to know. These are some of the WORST of the WORST:
**🔴 VIVEK RAMASWAMY – Ohio – Governor**
Vivek Ramaswamy is an out-of-touch billionaire who has said Medicare and Medicaid were “mistakes.” During his 2024 presidential campaign, he proposed ENDING birthright citizenship. And now Trump wants to put him in the governor's mansion in Ohio – a state where working families can't afford more MAGA experiments.
**🔴 MICHAEL WHATLEY – North Carolina – U.S. Senate**
Michael Whatley isn't just endorsed by Donald Trump – he was personally recruited by him. As RNC Chairman, he spread false claims about Democratic cities engaging in “massive fraud.” He spent years as a lobbyist for Big Oil companies. And now he’s hoping to buy North Carolina’s open U.S. Senate seat in what will be one of the most expensive + competitive races of the cycle.
**🔴 MIKE ROGERS – Michigan – U.S. Senate**
Mike Rogers has a long record of voting to cut Medicare, gut the Affordable Care Act, and block commonsense gun safety legislation – even after a school shooting in his own district. He accepted over $1 MILLION from the pharmaceutical industry and then fought to keep drug companies from having to negotiate lower prices for seniors. Trump proudly endorsed him anyway.
**🔴 BURT JONES – Georgia – Governor**
Burt Jones isn't just a Trump loyalist – he's one of the most brazen election deniers in the country. In December 2020, Jones was one of 16 Georgia Republicans who signed a false certificate declaring Trump the winner of the state in a scheme to overturn the Electoral College results. Now Trump has given him his “Complete and Total Endorsement.”
**The pattern here isn't an accident. Trump is endorsing candidates that will rubber-stamp his agenda, no matter who gets hurt.**
We can stop it. But only with your help, Peter.
